We challenge this compromise with FastDSAC, a framework that effectively unlocks the potential of maximum entropy stochastic policies for complex continuous control. We introduce Dimension-wise Entropy Modulation (DEM) to dynamically redistribute the exploration budget and enforce diversity, alongside a continuous distributional critic tailored to ensure value fidelity and mitigate high-dimensional value overestimation. Extensive evaluations on HumanoidBench and other continuous control tasks demonstrate that rigorously designed stochastic policies can consistently match or outperform deterministic baselines, achieving notable gains of 180\% and 400\% on the challenging \textit{Basketball} and \textit{Balance Hard} tasks.

AI.tldr: FastDSAC提出一种结合维度熵调制和连续分布式评论家的最大熵强化学习框架，解决了高维人形控制任务中探索效率低下和训练不稳定的问题，在HumanoidBench上显著优于确定性策略基线。
AI.motivation: 最大熵强化学习在高维人形控制任务中面临"维度灾难"问题，导致严重的探索效率低下和训练不稳定。当前主流范式倾向于使用确定性策略梯度结合大规模并行模拟来规避这一问题，但作者认为可以有效利用最大熵随机策略的潜力。
AI.method: 提出FastDSAC框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 维度熵调制(DEM)模块，动态重新分配探索预算并强制多样性；2) 连续分布式评论家，专门设计用于确保价值 fidelity 并缓解高维价值过估计问题。
AI.result: 在HumanoidBench和其他连续控制任务上的广泛评估表明，精心设计的随机策略能够持续匹配或超越确定性基线，在具有挑战性的Basketball任务上获得180%提升，在Balance Hard任务上获得400%提升。
AI.conclusion: 经过严格设计的随机策略可以在复杂连续控制任务中取得与确定性基线相当甚至更优的性能，最大熵方法在高维控制领域具有重要潜力。

title: A Spectral Revisit of the Distributional Bellman Operator under the Cramér Metric
summary: Distributional reinforcement learning (DRL) studies the evolution of full return distributions under Bellman updates rather than focusing on expected values. A classical result is that the distributional Bellman operator is contractive under the Cramér metric, which corresponds to an $L^2$ geometry on differences of cumulative distribution functions (CDFs). While this contraction ensures stability of policy evaluation, existing analyses remain largely metric, focusing on contraction properties without elucidating the structural action of the Bellman update on distributions. In this work, we analyse distributional Bellman dynamics directly at the level of CDFs, treating the Cramér geometry as the intrinsic analytical setting. At this level, the Bellman update acts affinely on CDFs and linearly on differences between CDFs, and its contraction property yields a uniform bound on this linear action. Building on this intrinsic formulation, we construct a family of regularised spectral Hilbert representations that realise the CDF-level geometry by exact conjugation, without modifying the underlying Bellman dynamics. The regularisation affects only the geometry and vanishes in the zero-regularisation limit, recovering the native Cramér metric. This framework clarifies the operator structure underlying distributional Bellman updates and provides a foundation for further functional and operator-theoretic analyses in DRL.

AI.tldr: 本文在CDF层面分析分布强化学习中的Bellman算子结构，将Bellman更新视为对CDF的仿射作用和对CDF差异的线性作用，建立了一套正则化谱Hilbert表示框架，阐明了分布强化学习中Bellman更新的算子结构。
AI.motivation: 现有分布强化学习的分析主要停留在度量层面，关注压缩性质而未阐明Bellman更新对分布的结构化作用。需要直接在CDF层面分析分布Bellman动力学的内在结构。
AI.method:
1. 在Cramér度量（对应CDFs差异的L^2几何）框架下直接在CDF层面分析分布Bellman动力学
2. 将Bellman更新视为在CDF上的仿射算子，在CDF差异上作为线性算子
3. 利用压缩性质得到该线性作用的统一界
4. 构建正则化谱Hilbert表示，通过精确共轭实现CDF层面几何，不修改底层Bellman动力学
AI.result: 在CDF层面揭示了Bellman更新的内在算子结构：更新对CDFs是仿射的，对CDF差异是线性的，且压缩性质给出线性作用的一致界。构造的正则化谱Hilbert表示族能够实现CDF几何，正则化仅影响几何而在零正则化极限下消失，恢复原生Cramér度量。
AI.conclusion: 本文框架阐明了分布Bellman更新的底层算子结构，为分布强化学习中的进一步泛函和算子理论分析提供了基础。

title: When Drafts Evolve: Speculative Decoding Meets Online Learning
summary: Speculative decoding has emerged as a widely adopted paradigm for accelerating large language model inference, where a lightweight draft model rapidly generates candidate tokens that are then verified in parallel by a larger target model. However, due to limited model capacity, drafts often struggle to approximate the target distribution, resulting in shorter acceptance lengths and diminished speedup. A key yet under-explored observation is that speculative decoding inherently provides verification feedback that quantifies the deviation between the draft and target models at no additional cost. This process naturally forms an iterative "draft commits-feedback provides-draft adapts" evolving loop, which precisely matches the online learning paradigm. Motivated by this connection, we propose OnlineSpec, a unified framework that systematically leverages interactive feedback to continuously evolve draft models. Grounded in dynamic regret minimization, we establish a formal link between online learning performance and speculative system's acceleration rate, and develop novel algorithms via modern online learning techniques, including optimistic online learning that adaptively reuses historical gradients as predictive update hints, and online ensemble learning that dynamically maintains multiple draft models. Our algorithms are equipped with theoretical justifications and improved acceleration rates, achieving up to 24% speedup over seven benchmarks and three foundation models.

AI.tldr: OnlineSpec将推测解码形式化为在线学习问题，利用验证反馈自适应进化草稿模型，在七个基准上实现最高24%加速。
AI.motivation: 当前推测解码中草稿模型受限于模型容量，难以准确近似目标分布，导致接受长度较短、加速效果不佳。关键观察是：推测解码的验证过程本身就能提供草稿模型与目标模型偏差的反馈信息，且无需额外成本。这一过程自然形成"草稿提交-反馈提供-草稿适应"的迭代循环，恰好匹配在线学习范式。
AI.method: 提出OnlineSpec框架，将推测解码形式化为在线学习问题。基于动态 regret 最小化理论，开发了两种新算法：(1)乐观在线学习算法，通过自适应重用历史梯度作为预测更新提示；(2)在线集成学习算法，动态维护多个草稿模型。两种算法均配备理论保证和改加速率。
AI.result: 在七个基准测试和三个基础模型上实现了最高24%的加速提升，验证了OnlineSpec框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OnlineSpec通过将推测解码与在线学习相结合，为大语言模型推理加速提供了一种新的统一框架。该方法利用验证反馈自适应地更新草稿模型，在理论上建立了在线学习性能与加速率之间的正式联系，在七个基准测试和三个基础模型上实现了高达24%的加速提升，证明了交互式反馈在迭代推理系统中的重要价值。

title: Spend Less, Reason Better: Budget-Aware Value Tree Search for LLM Agents
summary: Test-time scaling has become a dominant paradigm for improving LLM agent reliability, yet current approaches treat compute as an abundant resource, allowing agents to exhaust token and tool budgets on redundant steps or dead-end trajectories. Existing budget-aware methods either require expensive fine-tuning or rely on coarse, trajectory-level heuristics that cannot intervene mid-execution. We propose the Budget-Aware Value Tree (BAVT), a training-free inference-time framework that models multi-hop reasoning as a dynamic search tree guided by step-level value estimation within a single LLM backbone. Another key innovation is a budget-conditioned node selection mechanism that uses the remaining resource ratio as a natural scaling exponent over node values, providing a principled, parameter-free transition from broad exploration to greedy exploitation as the budget depletes. To combat the well-known overconfidence of LLM self-evaluation, BAVT employs a residual value predictor that scores relative progress rather than absolute state quality, enabling reliable pruning of uninformative or redundant tool calls. We further provide a theoretical convergence guarantee, proving that BAVT reaches a terminal answer with probability at least $1-ε$ under an explicit finite budget bound. Extensive evaluations on four multi-hop QA benchmarks across two model families demonstrate that BAVT consistently outperforms parallel sampling baselines. Most notably, BAVT under strict low-budget constraints surpasses baseline performance at $4\times$ the resource allocation, establishing that intelligent budget management fundamentally outperforms brute-force compute scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Budget-Aware Value Tree (BAVT)，一种无需训练的推理时框架，通过动态搜索树结合步级价值估计来管理多跳推理过程中的计算预算，解决现有方法在资源紧张时无法有效干预执行过程的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前测试时缩放方法将计算视为充足资源，导致智能体在冗余步骤或死胡同轨迹上耗尽token和工具预算。现有的预算感知方法要么需要昂贵的微调，要么依赖粗粒度的轨迹级启发式方法，无法在执行过程中进行干预。
AI.method: 提出三个核心创新：1) 将多跳推理建模为动态搜索树，在单一LLM主干内通过步级价值估计引导；2) 预算条件化节点选择机制，利用剩余资源比率作为节点值的自然缩放指数，实现从广泛探索到贪婪利用的原则性过渡；3) 残差价值预测器，评估相对进展而非绝对状态质量，以可靠地修剪无信息或冗余的工具调用。
AI.result: 在四个多跳QA基准上跨两个模型家族进行广泛评估，BAVT始终优于并行采样基线。在严格的低预算约束下，BAVT超越4倍资源分配的基线性能。
AI.conclusion: BAVT在理论上提供了收敛保证，在明确的有限预算下以至少1-ε的概率达到终端答案。实验表明，智能预算管理本质上优于暴力计算缩放。

title: Maximizing Incremental Information Entropy for Contrastive Learning
comment: ICLR 2026 (The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations) https://openreview.net/forum?id=XL7ValpExh
summary: Contrastive learning has achieved remarkable success in self-supervised representation learning, often guided by information-theoretic objectives such as mutual information maximization. Motivated by the limitations of static augmentations and rigid invariance constraints, we propose IE-CL (Incremental-Entropy Contrastive Learning), a framework that explicitly optimizes the entropy gain between augmented views while preserving semantic consistency. Our theoretical framework reframes the challenge by identifying the encoder as an information bottleneck and proposes a joint optimization of two components: a learnable transformation for entropy generation and an encoder regularizer for its preservation. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100, STL-10, and ImageNet demonstrate that IE-CL consistently improves performance under small-batch settings. Moreover, our core modules can be seamlessly integrated into existing frameworks. This work bridges theoretical principles and practice, offering a new perspective in contrastive learning.

AI.tldr: IE-CL（增量熵对比学习）是一种自监督表示学习框架，通过显式优化增强视图之间的熵增益同时保持语义一致性来改进对比学习。
AI.motivation: 当前对比学习方法受限于静态数据增强和刚性不变性约束，需要一种能够动态优化信息增益同时保持语义一致性的新框架。
AI.method: 将编码器视为信息瓶颈，提出两部分联合优化：1）熵生成的 可学习变换（learnable transformation）；2）编码器正则化器用于保持熵。核心模块可无缝集成到现有框架中。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL-10和ImageNet数据集上，特别是在小批量设置下，IE-CL一致性地提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作桥接了理论原则与实践，为对比学习提供了新视角，核心创新在于显式建模熵增益与语义一致性的平衡。

title: LightMoE: Reducing Mixture-of-Experts Redundancy through Expert Replacing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) based Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and computational efficiency. However, their deployment is often constrained by substantial memory demands, primarily due to the need to load numerous expert modules. While existing expert compression techniques like pruning or merging attempt to mitigate this, they often suffer from irreversible knowledge loss or high training overhead. In this paper, we propose a novel expert compression paradigm termed expert replacing, which replaces redundant experts with parameter-efficient modules and recovers their capabilities with low training costs. We find that even a straightforward baseline of this paradigm yields promising performance. Building on this foundation, we introduce LightMoE, a framework that enhances the paradigm by introducing adaptive expert selection, hierarchical expert construction, and an annealed recovery strategy. Experimental results show that LightMoE matches the performance of LoRA fine-tuning at a 30% compression ratio. Even under a more aggressive 50% compression rate, it outperforms existing methods and achieves average performance improvements of 5.6% across five diverse tasks. These findings demonstrate that LightMoE strikes a superior balance among memory efficiency, training efficiency, and model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LightMoE框架，通过专家替换范式压缩MoE大语言模型，在30%压缩率下匹配LoRA性能，50%压缩率下在五个任务上平均提升5.6%。
AI.motivation: MoE-based LLM部署受限于巨大的内存需求，现有的专家剪枝或合并方法存在不可逆知识丢失或高训练开销问题。
AI.method: 提出专家替换范式，用参数高效模块替换冗余专家并低成本恢复能力。LightMoE包含自适应专家选择、分层专家构建和退火恢复策略三个核心组件。
AI.result: 30%压缩率下匹配LoRA微调性能；50%压缩率下优于现有方法，在五个不同任务上平均提升5.6%。
AI.conclusion: LightMoE在内存效率、训练效率和模型性能之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: RetroReasoner: A Reasoning LLM for Strategic Retrosynthesis Prediction
summary: Retrosynthesis prediction is a core task in organic synthesis that aims to predict reactants for a given product molecule. Traditionally, chemists select a plausible bond disconnection and derive corresponding reactants, which is time-consuming and requires substantial expertise. While recent advancements in molecular large language models (LLMs) have made progress, many methods either predict reactants without strategic reasoning or conduct only a generic product analysis, rather than reason explicitly about bond-disconnection strategies that logically lead to the choice of specific reactants. To overcome these limitations, we propose RetroReasoner, a retrosynthetic reasoning model that leverages chemists' strategic thinking. RetroReasoner is trained using both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). For SFT, we introduce SyntheticRetro, a framework that generates structured disconnection rationales alongside reactant predictions. In the case of RL, we apply a round-trip accuracy as reward, where predicted reactants are passed through a forward synthesis model, and predictions are rewarded when the forward-predicted product matches the original input product. Experimental results show that RetroReasoner not only outperforms prior baselines but also generates a broader range of feasible reactant proposals, particularly in handling more challenging reaction instances.

AI.tldr: RetroReasoner是一种新型逆合成推理模型，通过监督微调和强化学习结合化学家战略思维，能够显式推理断键策略并生成可行的反应物预测，在基准测试中超越现有方法，尤其擅长处理困难反应案例。
AI.motivation: 传统逆合成预测依赖化学家选择合理的键断开并推导相应反应物，耗时且需要大量专业知识。现有的分子大语言模型虽然取得了进展，但多数方法要么缺乏战略推理地预测反应物，要么仅进行通用产品分析，而非显式推理断键策略来逻辑地选择特定反应物。
AI.method: 提出RetroReasoner模型，采用两种训练策略：1) 监督微调(SFT)：引入SyntheticRetro框架，生成结构化的断开原理并伴随反应物预测；2) 强化学习(RL)：使用往返准确度作为奖励信号，将预测的反应物通过正向合成模型传递，当正向预测的产品与原始输入产品匹配时给予奖励。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RetroReasoner不仅优于先前基准，还能生成更广泛的可行反应物建议，特别是在处理更具挑战性的反应实例时表现优异。
AI.conclusion: RetroReasoner通过结合监督微调和强化学习，成功地将化学家的战略思维融入逆合成预测中。该模型不仅在基准测试中超越了先前方法，还能生成更广泛的可行反应物建议，尤其在处理更具挑战性的反应实例时表现出色。这项工作为逆合成预测提供了一种新的思路，通过显式推理断键策略来指导反应物预测。

title: Graph In-Context Operator Networks for Generalizable Spatiotemporal Prediction
summary: In-context operator learning enables neural networks to infer solution operators from contextual examples without weight updates. While prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of this paradigm in leveraging vast datasets, a systematic comparison against single-operator learning using identical training data has been absent. We address this gap through controlled experiments comparing in-context operator learning against classical operator learning (single-operator models trained without contextual examples), under the same training steps and dataset. To enable this investigation on real-world spatiotemporal systems, we propose GICON (Graph In-Context Operator Network), combining graph message passing for geometric generalization with example-aware positional encoding for cardinality generalization. Experiments on air quality prediction across two Chinese regions show that in-context operator learning outperforms classical operator learning on complex tasks, generalizing across spatial domains and scaling robustly from few training examples to 100 at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了上下文运算符学习与经典运算符学习，提出GICON模型解决几何和基数泛化问题，在空气质量预测任务上验证了上下文运算符学习的优越性。
AI.motivation: 解决现有研究中缺乏对上下文运算符学习与单运算符学习在相同训练数据下进行系统比较的问题。需要在真实世界的时空系统上开展受控实验。
AI.method: 提出GICON (Graph In-Context Operator Network)，结合图消息传递实现几何泛化，以及示例感知位置编码实现基数泛化。在两个中国区域的空气质量预测任务上进行实验。
AI.result: 上下文运算符学习在复杂任务上优于经典运算符学习，能够跨空间域泛化，并能从少量训练样本鲁棒扩展到100个推理样本。
AI.conclusion: GICON通过结合图消息传递和示例感知位置编码，有效解决了上下文运算符学习的几何泛化和基数泛化问题。实验证明，上下文运算符学习在复杂任务上优于经典运算符学习，并具有良好的跨空间域泛化能力和从少到多训练样本的鲁棒扩展性。

title: TaoBench: Do Automated Theorem Prover LLMs Generalize Beyond MathLib?
summary: Automated theorem proving (ATP) benchmarks largely consist of problems formalized in MathLib, so current ATP training and evaluation are heavily biased toward MathLib's definitional framework. However, frontier mathematics is often exploratory and prototype-heavy, relying on bespoke constructions that deviate from standard libraries. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of current ATP systems when applied to a novel definitional framework, specifically examining the performance gap between standard library problems and bespoke mathematical constructions. We introduce TaoBench, an undergraduate-level benchmark derived from Terence Tao's Analysis I, which formalizes analysis by constructing core mathematical concepts from scratch, without relying on standard Mathlib definitions, as well as by mixing from-scratch and MathLib constructions. For fair evaluation, we build an agentic pipeline that automatically extracts a compilable, self-contained local environment for each problem. To isolate the effect of definitional frameworks, we additionally translate every problem into a mathematically equivalent Mathlib formulation, yielding paired TaoBench-Mathlib statements for direct comparison. While state-of-the-art ATP models perform capably within the MathLib framework, performance drops by an average of roughly 26% on the definitionally equivalent Tao formulation. This indicates that the main bottleneck is limited generalization across definitional frameworks rather than task difficulty. TaoBench thus highlights a gap between benchmark performance and applicability, and provides a concrete foundation for developing and testing provers better aligned with research mathematics.

AI.tldr: TaoBench是一个基于Tao《分析I》的ATP基准测试，用于评估ATP系统在不同定义框架下的性能。研究发现顶尖ATP模型在MathLib框架表现良好，但在等价的Tao表述上性能下降约26%，表明主要问题是跨定义框架泛化能力不足，而非任务本身难度。
AI.motivation: 当前ATP（自动定理证明）基准测试主要基于MathLib库，这导致训练和评估严重偏向于MathLib的定义框架。然而，当前数学前沿往往是探索性的，使用偏离标准库的自定义构造。该研究旨在评估当前ATP系统在新型定义框架下的鲁棒性，检验标准库问题与自定义数学构造之间的性能差距。
AI.method: 1. 构建TaoBench基准测试：从Terence Tao的《分析I》中提取本科级别的问题，这些问题从零开始构造核心数学概念，不依赖MathLib标准定义，并混合从零开始和MathLib构造两种方式。2. 构建智能体管道：自动为每个问题提取可编译的独立本地环境。3. 翻译对照：将每个问题翻译成数学上等价的Mathlib表述，产生配对的TaoBench-Mathlib陈述以进行直接比较。
AI.result: 最先进的ATP模型在MathLib框架内表现良好，但在数学等价的Tao表述上性能平均下降约26%。
AI.conclusion: 主要瓶颈是跨定义框架的泛化能力有限，而非任务难度。TaoBench揭示了基准测试性能与实际应用之间的差距，为开发更符合研究数学的证明器提供了具体基础。

title: Human-AI Collaborative Autonomous Experimentation With Proxy Modeling for Comparative Observation
summary: Optimization for different tasks like material characterization, synthesis, and functional properties for desired applications over multi-dimensional control parameters need a rapid strategic search through active learning such as Bayesian optimization (BO). However, such high-dimensional experimental physical descriptors are complex and noisy, from which realization of a low-dimensional mathematical scalar metrics or objective functions can be erroneous. Moreover, in traditional purely data-driven autonomous exploration, such objective functions often ignore the subtle variation and key features of the physical descriptors, thereby can fail to discover unknown phenomenon of the material systems. To address this, here we present a proxy-modelled Bayesian optimization (px-BO) via on-the-fly teaming between human and AI agents. Over the loop of BO, instead of defining a mathematical objective function directly from the experimental data, we introduce a voting system on the fly where the new experimental outcome will be compared with existing experiments, and the human agents will choose the preferred samples. These human-guided comparisons are then transformed into a proxy-based objective function via fitting Bradley-Terry (BT) model. Then, to minimize human interaction, this iteratively trained proxy model also acts as an AI agent for future surrogate human votes. Finally, these surrogate votes are periodically validated by human agents, and the corrections are then learned by the proxy model on-the-fly. We demonstrated the performance of the proposed px-BO framework into simulated and BEPS data generated from PTO sample. We find that our approach provided better control of the domain experts for an improved search over traditional data-driven exploration, thus, signifies the importance of human-AI teaming in an accelerated and meaningful material space exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"代理模型辅助的贝叶斯优化"（px-BO）框架，用Bradley-Terry模型将人类专家对新实验结果与既有实验的偏好比较（人-机投票）在线拟合为代理目标函数，从而在多维材料合成参数空间中实现人机协同的主动搜索，并以PTO（钙钛矿氧化物）样品的模拟数据与BEPS实验数据验证了其优于纯数据驱动自主探索的能力。
AI.motivation: 材料表征、合成与功能性能优化需要在多维控制参数空间（如温度、压力、成分、沉积条件等）中进行快速策略性搜索，贝叶斯优化(BO)是主流的主动学习范式。但存在两大问题：(1) 高维实验物理描述符（如光谱、XRD、XPS等）本身复杂、噪声大，若直接由其构造低维数学标量指标或目标函数，容易产生错误的映射与失真；(2) 传统纯数据驱动的自主探索所构造的目标函数往往忽略物理描述符中的细微变化与关键特征，导致无法发现材料体系中未知的现象。此外，纯自动化流程缺乏领域知识的引导，搜索效率与可解释性受限，因此需要引入人机协同。
AI.method: 核心思路是在BO的循环内部"即时组队"（on-the-fly teaming），而非事先人工定义目标函数。具体步骤：(1) 每轮BO由代理模型（surrogate）推荐候选实验参数并实际执行，得到新的实验结果（物理描述符）；(2) 将新结果与已有实验结果在某一物理描述符维度上进行两两比较，由人类专家（领域专家）投票选择更优样本，形成人类偏好比较数据集；(3) 用Bradley-Terry (BT) 成对比较模型对这些偏好数据进行拟合，得到一个"代理目标函数"（proxy-based objective），替代传统人工定义的数学目标函数来驱动BO的采集函数/效用计算；(4) 为最小化人力交互，已训练的代理模型同时充当"AI代理人类投票者"，对后续迭代的候选样本生成替代性（surrogate）投票；(5) 代理投票周期性交由人类专家进行验证/校验，人类纠正结果再被BT模型在线重新学习（在线更新代理模型），形成人机闭环迭代。验证对象为PTO（perovskite titanate oxide）样品：既在模拟数据（simulated）上测试，也使用BEPS（贝叶斯实验规划与选择/高通量实验生成）产生的真实实验数据评估。
AI.result: 在模拟数据与基于PTO样品的BEPS真实实验数据上，px-BO相较于传统纯数据驱动（无人类偏好介入）的自主探索，提供了更好的"域专家控制力"（domain experts retain control），实现了更优的搜索路径与目标区域的收敛/改进，表明人机协同的偏好嵌入能有效抑制错误目标函数带来的误导，并加速有意义的材料空间探索。
AI.conclusion: px-BO框架证明：把人类专家的定性偏好比较（而非预设数学目标函数）通过BT模型转化为可学习的代理目标函数，并让AI代理承担大部分投票、人类仅做周期性校验与纠正，可在最小化人工交互的前提下显著提升高维、噪声材料参数空间中的搜索质量。这强调了人-AI协同在加速且具物理意义（而非仅数据拟合意义）的材料空间探索中的重要性。局限与展望方面，该方法依赖专家比较的一致性与代理模型的排序表达能力，且示例仅局限于PTO一类材料体系与特定描述符维度，推广到更复杂体系需进一步验证。

title: Residual SODAP: Residual Self-Organizing Domain-Adaptive Prompting with Structural Knowledge Preservation for Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning (CL) suffers from catastrophic forgetting, which is exacerbated in domain-incremental learning (DIL) where task identifiers are unavailable and storing past data is infeasible. While prompt-based CL (PCL) adapts representations with a frozen backbone, we observe that prompt-only improvements are often insufficient due to suboptimal prompt selection and classifier-level instability under domain shifts. We propose Residual SODAP, which jointly performs prompt-based representation adaptation and classifier-level knowledge preservation. Our framework combines $α$-entmax sparse prompt selection with residual aggregation, data-free distillation with pseudo-feature replay, prompt-usage--based drift detection, and uncertainty-aware multi-loss balancing. Across three DIL benchmarks without task IDs or extra data storage, Residual SODAP achieves state-of-the-art AvgACC/AvgF of 0.850/0.047 (DR), 0.760/0.031 (Skin Cancer), and 0.995/0.003 (CORe50).

AI.tldr: 针对无任务标识和不可存储数据的域增量学习场景，提出Residual SODAP框架，通过稀疏提示选择、残差聚合、无数据蒸馏和漂移检测等技术联合优化表示学习和分类器，在三个基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 持续学习（CL）存在灾难性遗忘问题，在域增量学习（DIL）中尤为严重，因为DIL中任务标识符不可用且无法存储过去的数据。现有基于提示的CL（PCL）方法仅改进提示，但存在提示选择次优和分类器在域转移下不稳定的问题。
AI.method: 提出 Residual SODAP 框架，联合执行基于提示的表示适应和分类器级知识保留。框架包含四个核心组件：1) α-entmax稀疏提示选择；2) 残差聚合；3) 基于伪特征重放的无数据蒸馏；4) 基于提示使用的漂移检测；5) 不确定性感知的多损失平衡。
AI.result: 在三个无任务ID或额外数据存储的DIL基准数据集上取得最先进的性能：DR (0.850/0.047)、Skin Cancer (0.760/0.031)、CORe50 (0.995/0.003)（AvgACC/AvgF）。
AI.conclusion: Residual SODAP通过联合优化表示学习和分类器知识保留，有效缓解了DIL场景下的灾难性遗忘，在医疗和通用图像数据集上验证了其有效性。

title: Hierarchical Reference Sets for Robust Unsupervised Detection of Scattered and Clustered Outliers
summary: Most real-world IoT data analysis tasks, such as clustering and anomaly event detection, are unsupervised and highly susceptible to the presence of outliers. In addition to sporadic scattered outliers caused by factors such as faulty sensor readings, IoT systems often exhibit clustered outliers. These occur when multiple devices or nodes produce similar anomalous measurements, for instance, owing to localized interference, emerging security threats, or regional false alarms, forming micro-clusters. These clustered outliers can be easily mistaken for normal behavior because of their relatively high local density, thereby obscuring the detection of both scattered and contextual anomalies. To address this, we propose a novel outlier detection paradigm that leverages the natural neighboring relationships using graph structures. This facilitates multi-perspective anomaly evaluation by incorporating reference sets at both local and global scales derived from the graph. Our approach enables the effective recognition of scattered outliers without interference from clustered anomalies, whereas the graph structure simultaneously helps reflect and isolate clustered outlier groups. Extensive experiments, including comparative performance analysis, ablation studies, validation on downstream clustering tasks, and evaluation of hyperparameter sensitivity, demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method. The source code is available at https://github.com/gordonlok/DROD.

AI.tldr: 针对物联网数据中难以检测的聚类异常值问题，提出一种基于图结构和自然邻近关系的新型异常检测方法DROD，通过局部和全局参考集实现多视角异常评估，有效识别分散异常值的同时隔离聚类异常组。
AI.motivation: 物联网数据分析任务（如聚类、异常事件检测）通常是无监督的，极易受到异常值影响。除了由传感器故障等导致的零散异常值外，物联网系统还经常出现聚类异常值（多个设备因局部干扰、安全威胁或区域误报产生相似的异常测量形成微聚类）。这些聚类异常值因局部密度较高容易被误认为正常行为，从而掩盖了分散异常值和上下文异常的检测。
AI.method: 提出一种基于图结构的新型异常检测范式，利用自然邻近关系。通过从图中推导局部和全局尺度的参考集，实现多视角异常评估。该方法能够有效识别分散异常值而不受聚类异常干扰，同时图结构可反映和隔离聚类异常组。
AI.result: 广泛的实验验证表明方法有效，包括：对比性能分析、消融实验、下游聚类任务验证以及超参数敏感性评估。实验结果证明了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的DROD方法成功解决了物联网数据中同时存在分散异常值和聚类异常值的检测难题，通过图结构和自然邻近关系实现了多尺度异常评估，为物联网异常检测提供了一种新的有效范式。源代码已开源。

title: Adaptive Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Data and Model Fusion of Complex Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
summary: High-fidelity numerical simulations of chaotic, high dimensional nonlinear dynamical systems are computationally expensive, necessitating the development of efficient surrogate models. Most surrogate models for such systems are deterministic, for example when neural operators are involved. However, deterministic models often fail to capture the intrinsic distributional uncertainty of chaotic systems. This work presents a surrogate modeling formulation that leverages generative machine learning, where a deep learning diffusion model is used to probabilistically forecast turbulent flows over long horizons. We introduce a multi-step autoregressive diffusion objective that significantly enhances long-rollout stability compared to standard single-step training. To handle complex, unstructured geometries, we utilize a multi-scale graph transformer architecture incorporating diffusion preconditioning and voxel-grid pooling. More importantly, our modeling framework provides a unified platform that also predicts spatiotemporally important locations for sensor placement, either via uncertainty estimates or through an error-estimation module. Finally, the observations of the ground truth state at these dynamically varying sensor locations are assimilated using diffusion posterior sampling requiring no retraining of the surrogate model. We present our methodology on two-dimensional homogeneous and isotropic turbulence and for a flow over a backwards-facing step, demonstrating its utility in forecasting, adaptive sensor placement, and data assimilation for high dimensional chaotic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的生成式 surrogate modeling 框架，用于高维混沌动力系统的概率预测、自适应传感器部署和数据同化。
AI.motivation: 高保真数值模拟计算成本高昂，现有的确定性 surrogate 模型无法捕捉混沌系统的内在分布不确定性。
AI.method: 提出多步自回归扩散目标以增强长期 rollout 稳定性；采用多尺度图 transformer 架构（包含扩散预处理和体素池化）；通过不确定性估计或误差估计模块实现自适应传感器部署；使用扩散后验采样进行数据同化，无需重新训练模型。
AI.result: 在二维均匀各向同性湍流和背风台阶流上验证了方法在预测、自适应传感器部署和数据同化方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高维混沌系统提供了统一的概率预测、自适应传感器部署和数据同化平台。

title: Surprised by Attention: Predictable Query Dynamics for Time Series Anomaly Detection
comment: Main: 17 Pages, 7 Figures, 3 Tables; Appendix: 3 Pages, 4 Tables
summary: Multivariate time series anomalies often manifest as shifts in cross-channel dependencies rather than simple amplitude excursions. In autonomous driving, for instance, a steering command might be internally consistent but decouple from the resulting lateral acceleration. Residual-based detectors can miss such anomalies when flexible sequence models still reconstruct signals plausibly despite altered coordination. We introduce AxonAD, an unsupervised detector that treats multi-head attention query evolution as a short horizon predictable process. A gradient-updated reconstruction pathway is coupled with a history-only predictor that forecasts future query vectors from past context. This is trained via a masked predictor-target objective against an exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder. At inference, reconstruction error is combined with a tail-aggregated query mismatch score, which measures cosine deviation between predicted and target queries on recent timesteps. This dual approach provides sensitivity to structural dependency shifts while retaining amplitude-level detection. On proprietary in-vehicle telemetry with interval annotations and on the TSB-AD multi-variate suite (17 datasets, 180 series) with threshold-free and range-aware metrics, AxonAD improves ranking quality and temporal localization over strong baselines. Ablations confirm that query prediction and combined scoring are the primary drivers of the observed gains. Code is available at the URL https://github.com/iis-esslingen/AxonAD.

AI.tldr: AxonAD是一种无监督多变量时间序列异常检测方法，通过将多头注意力查询演化视为短期可预测过程，结合梯度更新的重建路径与历史预测器来检测跨通道依赖变化。在车载遥测数据和TSB-AD多变量基准数据集上，该方法在排序质量和时间定位方面优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 当前多变量时间序列异常通常表现为跨通道依赖的变化，而非简单的幅度波动。现有基于残差的检测器在灵活序列模型能够 plausibly 重建信号时可能遗漏此类结构性依赖偏移异常。
AI.method: 提出AxonAD框架：1)将多头注意力查询演化建模为短期可预测过程；2)构建梯度更新的重建路径与历史预测器的耦合；3)使用掩码预测器-目标目标函数结合指数移动平均(EMA)目标编码器进行训练；4)推理时融合重建误差与尾部聚合查询不匹配分数(预测查询与目标查询的余弦偏差)。
AI.result: 在专有车载遥测数据(带区间标注)和TSB-AD多变量套件(17个数据集,180个序列)上，AxonAD在排序质量和时间定位方面优于强基线。消融实验确认查询预测和组合评分是主要性能驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过双管齐下(重建误差+查询不匹配评分)既保持了对幅度级别异常的敏感性，又能检测结构性依赖偏移，为多变量时间序列异常检测提供了一种有效框架。

title: Sobolev--Ricci Curvature
summary: Ricci curvature is a fundamental concept in differential geometry for encoding local geometric structure, and its graph-based analogues have recently gained prominence as practical tools for reweighting, pruning, and reshaping network geometry. We propose Sobolev-Ricci Curvature (SRC), a graph Ricci curvature canonically induced by Sobolev transport geometry, which admits efficient evaluation via a tree-metric Sobolev structure on neighborhood measures. We establish two consistency behaviors that anchor SRC to classical transport curvature: (i) on trees endowed with the length measure, SRC recovers Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC) in the canonical W1 setting, and (ii) SRC vanishes in the Dirac limit, matching the flat case of measure-theoretic Ricci curvature. We demonstrate SRC as a reusable curvature primitive in two representative pipelines. We define Sobolev-Ricci Flow by replacing ORC with SRC in a Ricci-flow-style reweighting rule, and we use SRC for curvature-guided edge pruning aimed at preserving manifold structure. Overall, SRC provides a transport-based foundation for scalable curvature-driven graph transformation and manifold-oriented pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sobolev-Ricci曲率(SRC)，一种由Sobolev传输几何规范诱导的图Ricci曲率，通过邻域测度的树度量Sobolev结构实现高效计算。SRC在树上的长度测度下可恢复Ollivier-Ricci曲率(ORC)，并在Dirac极限下消失，证明与经典传输曲率的一致性。实验展示了SRC在Sobolev-Ricci流重加权和流形结构保留的曲率导向边剪枝中的应用价值。
AI.motivation: Ricci curvature is a fundamental concept in differential geometry for encoding local geometric structure. Graph-based analogues have gained prominence as practical tools for reweighting, pruning, and reshaping network geometry. However, existing methods may lack scalability or canonical consistency with classical transport curvature. This work aims to propose a new graph Ricci curvature that is canonically induced by Sobolev transport geometry and admits efficient evaluation.
AI.method: The authors propose Sobolev-Ricci Curvature (SRC), a graph Ricci curvature canonically induced by Sobolev transport geometry. SRC admits efficient evaluation via a tree-metric Sobolev structure on neighborhood measures. Two consistency behaviors are established: (i) on trees with length measure, SRC recovers Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC) in the canonical W1 setting; (ii) SRC vanishes in the Dirac limit, matching the flat case of measure-theoretic Ricci curvature.
AI.result: The proposed SRC provides a transport-based foundation for scalable curvature-driven graph transformation. Two representative pipelines are demonstrated: (1) Sobolev-Ricci Flow, which replaces ORC with SRC in a Ricci-flow-style reweighting rule; (2) curvature-guided edge pruning aimed at preserving manifold structure.
AI.conclusion: SRC provides a transport-based foundation for scalable curvature-driven graph transformation and manifold-oriented pruning. It bridges graph curvature with classical transport geometry through Sobolev structure, offering both theoretical consistency and practical utility.

title: Competition-Aware CPC Forecasting with Near-Market Coverage
summary: Cost-per-click (CPC) in paid search is a volatile auction outcome generated by a competitive landscape that is only partially observable from any single advertiser's history. Using Google Ads auction logs from a concentrated car-rental market (2021--2023), we forecast weekly CPC for 1,811 keyword series and approximate latent competition through complementary signals derived from keyword text, CPC trajectories, and geographic market structure. We construct (i) semantic neighborhoods and a semantic keyword graph from pretrained transformer-based representations of keyword text, (ii) behavioral neighborhoods via Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) alignment of CPC trajectories, and (iii) geographic-intent covariates capturing localized demand and marketplace heterogeneity. We extensively evaluate these signals both as stand-alone covariates and as relational priors in spatiotemporal graph forecasters, benchmarking them against strong statistical, neural, and time-series foundation-model baselines. Across methods, competition-aware augmentation improves stability and error profiles at business-relevant medium and longer horizons, where competitive regimes shift and volatility is most consequential. The results show that broad market-outcome coverage, combined with keyword-derived semantic and geographic priors, provides a scalable way to approximate latent competition and improve CPC forecasting in auction-driven markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Paid Search中CPC预测问题，提出通过语义邻域、行为邻域和地理-意图协变量来近似潜在于竞争，并评估这些信号作为协变量和时空图预测器中的关系先验的效果。
AI.motivation: CPC是由竞争性拍卖产生的高度波动结果，但任何单个广告商的历史只能观察到部分竞争格局。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练Transformer生成关键词文本的语义表示，构建语义邻域和语义关键词图；2) 使用动态时间规整(DTW)对齐CPC轨迹构建行为邻域；3) 构建捕捉本地化需求和市场异质性的地理-意图协变量；4) 在时空图预测器中将这些信号作为关系先验进行评估。
AI.result: 竞争感知增强在商业相关的中长期预测中改善了稳定性和误差轮廓，竞争优势 regime 转换和波动性最显著时效果最好。广泛的市场结果覆盖结合关键词衍生的语义和地理先验提供了一种可扩展的方法来近似潜在于竞争并改善拍卖驱动市场的CPC预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合语义、行为和地理信号来近似潜在于竞争可以显著提升CPC预测效果，特别是在波动性较高的中长预测 horizon。该方法为拍卖驱动市场的竞争感知预测提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion for Solving Parameterized PDEs
summary: Generalizing neural surrogate models across different PDE parameters remains difficult because changes in PDE coefficients often make learning harder and optimization less stable. The problem becomes even more severe when the model must also predict beyond the training time range. Existing methods usually cannot handle parameter generalization and temporal extrapolation at the same time. Standard parameterized models treat time as just another input and therefore fail to capture intrinsic dynamics, while recent continuous-time latent methods often rely on expensive test-time auto-decoding for each instance, which is inefficient and can disrupt continuity across the parameterized solution space. To address this, we propose Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion (DLDMF), a physics-informed framework that explicitly separates space, time, and parameters. Instead of unstable auto-decoding, DLDMF maps PDE parameters directly to a continuous latent embedding through a feed-forward network. This embedding initializes and conditions a latent state whose evolution is governed by a parameter-conditioned Neural ODE. We further introduce a dynamic manifold fusion mechanism that uses a shared decoder to combine spatial coordinates, parameter embeddings, and time-evolving latent states to reconstruct the corresponding spatiotemporal solution. By modeling prediction as latent dynamic evolution rather than static coordinate fitting, DLDMF reduces interference between parameter variation and temporal evolution while preserving a smooth and coherent solution manifold. As a result, it performs well on unseen parameter settings and in long-term temporal extrapolation. Experiments on several benchmark problems show that DLDMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy, parameter generalization, and extrapolation robustness.

AI.tldr: DLDMF 把「空间—参数—时间」三路表征解耦：参数经前馈编码器直接生成潜在初始状态 z0(μ) 并条件化 Neural ODE 向量场，演化得到的潜变量 zt(μ) 与空间编码 hx、参数编码 hμ 拼接后由共享解码器重建时空解；配合物理残差/初边条件/潜场雅可比正则的训练目标，实现无需测试时自解码的参数泛化与时间外推。CDR（1D/2D/3D）、2D Navier–Stokes、Helmholtz 基准上一致优于 PINN、P²INN、DINO、PIDO、MAD；典型 CDR 上测试集 In-t/Out-t 相对 L² 误差为 1.89%/4.21%（P²INN 为 21.34%/32.87%）。
AI.motivation: 参数化 PDE 的神经代理模型面临两个长期未解难题：一是系数（对流 β、扩散 ν、反应 ρ、雷诺数 Re 等）变化会同时加大拟合难度并使优化不稳；二是要在训练时间窗之外做有限时域外推。现有路线各有硬缺陷：PINN/P²INN 把时间当作普通输入坐标，缺少显式动力学，训练窗外靠坐标外推，误差随时间近似线性增长（文中 Fig.2/3 显示 t=1.0 尚可、t=5.0/10.0 形状与量级均严重失真）；DINO/PIDO 等连续时间潜变量方法虽用 Neural ODE 建模隐式动力学，但依赖对每个实例做测试时自编码（auto-decoding）迭代优化来推断潜初始状态，推理代价随查询数增长，且自编码的实例级潜码会破坏参数化解流形在参数空间中的连续性；MAD 亦属逐实例潜优化。此外 DINO/PIDO 的泛化来源是初值观测而非参数向量，与"参数主导变化"的参数化设定错配。作者期望一个既能在未见参数上直接前馈推理、又能显式积分潜动力学外推时间的统一架构。
AI.method: 架构（DLDMF）：四类可训练模块 Θ={θx, θp, θ0, θf, θg}。空间编码 hx=g_θx(x)；参数编码 hμ=g_θp(μ)；前馈潜在初始化 z0(μ)=g_θ0(hμ)（取代自解码）；参数条件化 Neural ODE：dz_t/dt=f_θf(z_t, hμ)，流映射 φ_t；动态流形融合 F_cat=[hx; zt(μ); hμ] 拼接后经共享非线性解码器 D_θd=g_θg 重建 û(x,t;μ)。时间导数按链式法则由解码器对潜时间块的雅可比 J_z D_θd(m)·f_θf(z_t,hμ) 给出，空间导数经自动微分获得。训练目标：λu 归一化监督损失（分母加 ε_den 正则）+ λr PDE 强形式残差 + λ0 初值 + λb 边界 + λJ 潜向量场雅可比 Frobenius 范数平方正则（抑制潜轨迹振荡、稳定有限时域外推）+ λwd 权重衰减；每步 mini-batch 混合多个参数实例以学习共享参数化解流形。适配机制：对目标参数可选仅解码器侧微调，比较激活空间调制（Shift/Scale/FiLM）与权重空间调制（GFM、沿预训练权重 SVD 奇异方向的增益调制 a_l，首末层与 U,V 固定）、全解码器微调与固定预训练。理论部分给出条件性有限时域分析：Prop 4.1 预测关于 (x,t,μ) 的连续性；Cor 4.2 参数距离依赖误差界（误差 ≤ 训练点误差 + (K_Θ(t)+K_*(t))·||μ-μ0||）；Prop 4.3 潜流扰动界（由一侧 Lipschitz 常数 α* 与 Grönwall 得出 e^{α*t}ε0 + χ_{α*}(t)(ε_f+L*_μ ε_μ)）；Cor 4.4 潜流到输出的 L_H 传播；Prop 4.5 输出误差分解 L_H(εx+εz(t)+εμ)+ε_rec+ε_man；Cor 4.6 合并有限时域界；Prop 4.7 单步 p 阶法数值潜流收敛（解误差 O(Δt^p)，解码误差 ≤ L_D L_F C_T Δt^p）；Prop 4.8 潜 ODE 对参数与参数的灵敏度方程及 e^{L_z t} 增长界（α*<0 意味收缩潜流）。实验设置：CDR 族（d_x∈{1,2,3}，参考解用 Strang 算子分裂）、2D 不可压 Navier–Stokes（Re∈{100,500,1000,5000}，周期边界）、2D 制造解 Helmholtz（k=1，参数为源频率对）；时间划分训练窗 [0,T_tr] 与外推窗 (T_tr,T_te]，参数划分 conv(P_train) 内的插值参数与外的外推参数，构成 S1–S4 四种评测制度；指标为按参数等权平均的相对 L² 误差，并区分 In-t/Out-t。
AI.result: 1) 主结果（CDR 时间评估）：DLDMF Train In-t/Out-t 1.35%/3.15%，Test 1.89%/4.21%；P²INN 8.45%/15.23% 与 21.34%/32.87%；PIDO 1.58%/3.89% 与 5.67%/8.94%；DINO 随训练数据比例下降（100%→12.5%）In-t 变好但 Out-t 与测试误差急剧恶化（最高 31.74%），印证"训练窗内拟合"与"外推/泛化"需分离评价。2) 参数扫描：对流 β 从 2.55%→5.27%（P²INN 5.80%→17.90%），扩散 ν=10 时 5.62% vs 28.40%，反应 ρ=10 时 3.59% vs 44.90%，P²INN 误差随参数几乎单调增长而 DLDMF 保持近似平坦。3) 跨方程族（六种 CDR 组合）：误差由 12.30/18.50/25.60/15.20/22.80/32.10% 降至 3.50/4.20/3.80/5.10/6.30/7.20%，相对降幅 66.4%–85.2%。4) Navier–Stokes：Re=100/500/1000/5000 平均误差由 5.84/9.17/12.96/≥40.00% 降至 1.49/1.98/2.58/6.52%（相对降幅 74%–83.7%），但 DLDMF 误差随 Re 增大单调上升（黏性平滑减弱带来的敏感性）。5) Helmholtz 定常场：仅定性证据，DLDMF 保持节点布局/频率/幅值，两基线在高频外推时相位与幅值失真。6) 计算效率权衡：Out-t 对流查询上 DLDMF 误差 0.14% vs P²INN 41.75%，但单查询延迟 1.96 ms vs 0.34 ms，峰值内存 30.05 vs 29.49 MB，参数规模相当（约 7.6e4）——精度换延迟；DLDMF 无测试时梯度更新。7) 消融：潜雅可比正则显著降低潜振荡与误差峰；时间模块对比中 Neural ODE 误差最低（1.01%，0.24M 参数，1941 s），Latent ODE 推理最快（51 s，1.15%），Hypersolver 最小但误差最高（1.44%，2778 s），Neural Flow 最大最慢（0.40M，4319 s，1.24%）；解码器调制中 SVD 奇异方向增益微调在 100 步后误差最低（优于 Shift/Scale/FiLM/GFM/全微调）；配点密度 5%→100% 时 In-μ 误差 0.140%→0.103%、Out-μ 0.201%→0.128%，参数偏移始终比配点密度更难；潜动力学漂移实验中 DLDMF 误差跨训练边界基本持平（In-t 0.18%/Out-t 0.17%），P²INN 在 t≈0.5 峰值 18.6%、边界处仍>14%。8) 需要注意的方法学保留：表中 PIDO/DINO 部分数值引自已发表工作而非同预算重跑；DLDMF 的部分诊断（如 Table 5 的 0.14%–0.25%、Fig.14 的 3.47%/5.30% 等）使用"特征坐标/周期相位对齐 + 标定 checkpoint"，而基线为未对齐的端到端外推，两者不完全可比；多数表格为单次运行点估计而非多种子聚合；Helmholtz 仅定性、理论界均建立在"理想表示可实现 + 常数有界"等强条件下，未给出对真实训练过程的定量保证；S4（联合参数–时间外推）被单独讨论且定量表缺失。
AI.conclusion: DLDMF 用"参数→潜初始状态 + 参数条件化潜 ODE + 三路表征动态流形融合"把参数化 PDE 的参数泛化与时间外推统一到一个物理约束架构中，取代了逐实例自解码，也摆脱了把时间当坐标的静态外推，从而在 CDR、Navier–Stokes 上取得明显更低的 In-t/Out-t 误差并保持解流形的光滑性。理论上给出以潜向量场一侧稳定性 α* 与数值阶 p 为核心的有限时域误差传播刻画，指出"参数化初始化 + 潜流稳定性 + 解码正则性 + 求解器精度"是决定外推成败的关键量。局限与展望：参数空间覆盖度不足、边界感知参数采样、参数敏感性正则、刚性/结构保持型潜积分器、求解器相关的计算成本、对极端参数漂移下时间预测的鲁棒性、以及跨独立训练的系统性方差量化均待进一步研究；此外公平对比（统一预算、统一坐标对齐方式、多种子统计）与更充分的定量 S4 评测仍是必要补充。

title: L2GTX: From Local to Global Time Series Explanations
comment: Accepted for publication at the 4th World Conference on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (xAI 2026), 18 pages, 6 figures
summary: Deep learning models achieve high accuracy in time series classification, yet understanding their class-level decision behaviour remains challenging. Explanations for time series must respect temporal dependencies and identify patterns that recur across instances. Existing approaches face three limitations: model-agnostic XAI methods developed for images and tabular data do not readily extend to time series, global explanation synthesis for time series remains underexplored, and most existing global approaches are model-specific. We propose L2GTX, a model-agnostic framework that generates class-wise global explanations by aggregating local explanations from a representative set of instances. L2GTX extracts clusters of parameterised temporal event primitives, such as increasing or decreasing trends and local extrema, together with their importance scores from instance-level explanations produced by LOMATCE. These clusters are merged across instances to reduce redundancy, and an instance-cluster importance matrix is used to estimate global relevance. Under a user-defined instance selection budget, L2GTX selects representative instances that maximise coverage of influential clusters. Events from the selected instances are then aggregated into concise class-wise global explanations. Experiments on six benchmark time series datasets show that L2GTX produces compact and interpretable global explanations while maintaining stable global faithfulness measured as mean local surrogate fidelity.

AI.tldr: L2GTX 是一个完全模型无关（model-agnostic）的时间序列分类器全局解释框架：它先调用 LOMATCE 为每个实例生成基于参数化时间事件基元（增加/下降趋势、局部极大/极小值）的局部解释，再跨实例做凝聚层次聚类以合并冗余簇，构建“实例–簇”重要性矩阵，计算全局簇重要性，最后在用户设定的实例预算 B 下贪心（子模）选择能最大化覆盖高影响簇的代表实例，并将这些实例中的事件按属性统计量（均值±标准差）汇总为类别级（class-wise）紧凑全局解释。实验在 6 个 UCR 数据集、FCN 与 LSTM-FCN 两种架构上表明：随合并百分位 p 增大全局簇数量单调下降，而全局忠实度 GF（所选实例上的平均局部代理保真度 R²）保持稳定（多数约 0.50–0.83，置信区间重叠），说明压缩解释空间不损失对黑盒行为的忠实性，且所得模式与领域知识（ECG 形态学、咖啡光谱学）一致。
AI.motivation: 深度时序分类器虽精度高，但类别级决策行为不透明。时序解释必须保留时间依赖、事件时长与跨样本复现性，存在三点缺口：(1) 面向图像/表格的模型无关 XAI 方法（如 LIME、SHAP）把时间步当作独立特征，难以迁移到时序；(2) 时序的全局解释合成研究不足；(3) 少数全局方法（如 CAM/LRP 扩展、基于激活/滤波器的规则抽取）大多绑定特定架构，损害架构中立性。此外，作者先前基于决策树代理规则抽取的全局解释器只依赖代理模型逼近质量，缺少对实例级解释保真度、覆盖度与代表性的显式控制，因此需要一个从忠实局部解释出发、可控预算的局部到全局（local-to-global）合成机制。
AI.method: 五步流水线：(1) 局部归因——LOMATCE 通过对时间片段随机扰动生成邻域样本，用 FastDTW 计算距离并以 exp(-d²/σ²) 加权，提取 PEP（increasing/decreasing 参数化为 start_time、duration、avg_gradient；local max/min 参数化为 time、value），对每类事件做 K-means（k 由轮廓法确定），构建计数型事件矩阵 Z，并用加权岭回归拟合黑盒预测得到簇重要度 β̂，保留 top-n 簇；(2) 跨实例合并——按事件类型对局部簇质心做事件级凝聚层次聚类，用合并距离的 p 百分位 τ 切树得到全局簇 G，构造实例–簇重要性矩阵 M（式2）；(3) 全局重要性——仿 SP-LIME 的 I_j = sqrt(Σ_i |M_{i,j}|)，把每个全局簇视作一个“特征”；(4) 预算内选择——贪心子模选择，每步选使未覆盖簇的加权重要性增益最大的实例，直到 |S| = B；(5) 全局合成——扁平化所选实例中属于被覆盖簇的全部事件，按属性计算均值与标准差：趋势簇以 start_time±σ、duration±σ 描述，极值簇以 time±σ、value±σ 描述，形成类别级可解释摘要。实验上每类采样 n_inst=15（FordA/FordB/CBF 为 30），B = n_inst，p ∈ {25,50,75,95}，默认可视化用 p=95；数据集为 UCR 的 ECG200、GunPoint、Coffee、FordA、FordB、CBF；黑盒为 FCN（滤波 128/256/128，核 7/5/3 + BN + ReLU + GAP + softmax）与 LSTM-FCN，早停 patience 15，100 次随机划分训练取均值与 95% CI；指标为 Global Faithfulness（所选实例局部代理 R² 的均值，宏平均），3 个随机种子。
AI.result: (1) 在 6 个数据集、两种架构、4 个合并百分位下 GF 保持稳定：FCN 如 ECG200 0.780–0.792、FordA 0.672–0.674、CBF 0.625–0.633；LSTM-FCN 如 ECG200 0.828–0.832、GunPoint 0.588–0.638、CBF 0.502–0.519，各设置 95% CI 几乎全部重叠，说明解释空间的强压缩（高 p 合并）不会牺牲全局忠实度。(2) 随 p 增大，全局簇数量单调减少，形成更紧凑的解释空间，但保留了共享的决策相关线索。(3) 可解释性案例（ECG200、Coffee）：Coffee 中两个模型都关注 t∈[210,240] 的重叠光谱区域，但 Robusta 类的重要性集中于高幅值局部极大值，Arabica 类则更分散、包含较低强度峰与局部极小值，与 El-Abassy 等的咖啡光谱学结论一致；ECG200 中正常心跳表现为更多中等重要度的分散事件，心肌梗死信号由更少、更显著的偏移与转折主导，与 ECG 形态学的定性描述吻合，且不依赖临床标注。(4) 两种架构在类别上强调重叠的时间区域但簇重要性配置不同，反映架构归纳偏置差异，说明 L2GTX 既捕捉行为一致的全局解释，又对模型依赖时间信息的方式敏感。(5) 局限：LOMATCE 中事件聚类是最耗时的环节，长序列或大邻域下开销显著（已通过多核并行与子集轮廓估计缓解），大规模/资源受限场景的可扩展性仍待改进。
AI.conclusion: L2GTX 提供了一条原则性的局部到全局路径：不用单一全局代理模型，而是从忠实的实例级解释出发，经重要性感知的层次聚类合并、子模式预算化实例选择与属性级统计汇总，生成类别级、模型无关的全局时序解释。其贡献在于同时满足三项性质：压缩后的紧凑性、对黑盒行为的稳定全局忠实度，以及与领域语义对齐的可读事件模式。不足之处包括计算成本主要落在局部事件聚类、目前仅支持单变量时序、缺少以领域专家为核心的人本评估、以及缺乏与其它全局时序解释基线的直接定量对比。未来工作方向为扩展到多变量时序（处理通道间交互与依赖）、开展专家结构化的人本评估（有用性、清晰度、可信度），以及进一步提升事件级聚类的效率与可扩展性。

title: GeoChemAD: Benchmarking Unsupervised Geochemical Anomaly Detection for Mineral Exploration
summary: Geochemical anomaly detection plays a critical role in mineral exploration as deviations from regional geochemical baselines may indicate mineralization. Existing studies suffer from two key limitations: (1) single region scenarios which limit model generalizability; (2) proprietary datasets, which makes result reproduction unattainable. In this work, we introduce \textbf{GeoChemAD}, an open-source benchmark dataset compiled from government-led geological surveys, covering multiple regions, sampling sources, and target elements. The dataset comprises eight subsets representing diverse spatial scales and sampling conditions. To establish strong baselines, we reproduce and benchmark a range of unsupervised anomaly detection methods, including statistical models, generative and transformer-based approaches. Furthermore, we propose \textbf{GeoChemFormer}, a transformer-based framework that leverages self-supervised pretraining to learn target-element-aware geochemical representations for spatial samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoChemFormer consistently achieves superior and robust performance across all eight subsets, outperforming existing unsupervised methods in both anomaly detection accuracy and generalization capability. The proposed dataset and framework provide a foundation for reproducible research and future development in this direction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GeoChemAD——首个覆盖多区域、多采样介质（沉积物/岩石屑/土壤）、多目标元素（Au/Cu/Ni/W）、多空间尺度的开源地球化学异常检测（GAD）基准数据集（源自西澳地质调查局 GSWA DMPE 数据集，含 8 个子集）；同时系统复现并基准对比了统计、经典机器学习与深度生成/Transformer 等 12 种无监督异常检测方法，并提出基于自监督预训练的 Transformer 框架 GeoChemFormer，通过"空间上下文学习 + 元素依赖建模"两阶段实现目标元素感知的异常检测，在全部 8 个子集上取得最优平均 AUC（0.7712）。
AI.motivation: 地球化学异常检测是矿产勘查的核心手段，但既有研究存在两大缺陷：(1) 几乎都在单一区域（多为中国地质调查局的金矿数据集、沉积物介质）上验证，限制了模型跨场景泛化性评估；(2) 使用私有数据集，结果无法复现、方法间无法公平比较，且部分工作未公开关键元数据。此外，无监督方法检测到的"异常"未必与目标矿化元素相关，缺乏目标元素感知的特征学习是悬而未决的问题。为此需要一个标准化、开放、可复现的基准数据集与强基线。
AI.method: 【数据集】从 GSWA DMPE 数据中心的加速地球科学计划（源自 MINEDEX）获取 CM02 近地表地球化学与 CM01 矿化点数据，统一到 GDA2020 坐标系，手工选取采样点分布较均匀的多个区域，按采样介质（sediment/rock chip/soil）与目标元素划分为 8 个子集（sed1/sed2、rock1-3、soil1-3），采样点数 224–21040，面积约 2–8500 km²，采样间距 0.05–2.48 km，元素数 124 或 126。每子集提供样本 CSV（含 SAMPLEID、SAMPLETYPE、坐标与多元素浓度，保留 -9999 等异常值）与已知矿化点 CSV（含 SiteID、ProjectID、坐标）。任务定义为：无监督训练异常打分函数 V，矿化点得分高、背景点（随机抽取）得分低，主指标为 20 次重复背景采样平均 AUC，附录补充空间定位与空间一致性指标（DTD、AP、PR-AUC 等）。【GeoChemFormer】两阶段：第一阶段空间上下文学习——对每个查询点用 KD-tree 取 K 近邻，构造 token [Δx, Δy, f]，序列 S=[e, q_i, t_1..t_K]（e 为目标元素 token，q_i 为坐标线性投影+2D 位置编码），经 L 层 Transformer 编码器得到 q_i'，用 MSE 损失预测查询点目标元素浓度（不使用该点自身地球化学值）；第二阶段元素依赖建模——输入序列 [W_g q_i', u_1..u_c]，元素 token u_c = W_e[Embed(c) | W_v x_{i,c}] 融合元素身份嵌入与浓度标量，Transformer 编码后由共享线性解码器重建各元素浓度，异常分数为全元素 MSE 重建误差均值。【预处理】异常值（缺失/负/零）以 1/2 检出限替换或剔除；闭合约束用 CLR/ILR 对数比变换；特征选择对比 NA/人工/PCA/因果发现(CD)/LLM 辅助；栅格化用 IDW 与 Kriging 插值。【基线】Z-score、Mahalanobis 距离、kNN、Isolation Forest、One-Class SVM、AE、VAE、VAE-GAN、VAE-cascade-GAN、VAE-Diffusion、Vanilla Transformer (T1)，全部在单张 RTX A6000 上用 PyTorch 实现。
AI.result: 【总体性能】统计方法最弱（ZS 0.5011、MD 0.5339、KNN 0.5840），经典 ML 居中（IF 0.5809、OSVM 0.5615），深度生成模型更强（AE 0.7046、VAE-GAN 0.7279、VAE-Diffusion 0.6318），Transformer 更优（T1 0.7147），GeoChemFormer (T2) 最佳，平均 AUC 0.7712 且方差极低（0.0039，稳定性最高之一），在 8 个子集上整体最优/接近最优（如 rock1 0.7844、soil1 0.8704、soil3 0.8334、rock2 0.8050），但个别子集非最佳（rock3 0.7302 低于 T1 0.7986；sed2 0.7339 低于 AE 0.7991），说明 GAD 仍对数据集特性敏感。【预处理消融】ILR 平均 0.6788 略优于 CLR 0.6771，Raw 最差 0.6406；对 Au 目标数据集对数比变换提升约 +0.05，对 Cu 目标几乎无影响；Transformer 系模型一致偏好 ILR。特征选择上自动化方法优于人工选择，LLM 选择平均 0.7412 vs 人工 0.6419；GeoChemFormer 以 PCA 特征最佳（0.9427），深度模型对特征选择更鲁棒而经典模型敏感。插值上 Au 目标偏好 IDW、Ni 目标偏好 Kriging，1 km 采样数据集整体最佳（0.8080），100 m 密集采样下两策略差异最大（达 0.2664）。【消融】SCL 预训练收敛快（rock2 20 epoch 峰值 0.919、sed1 40 epoch 0.743、soil2 60 epoch 0.821）；K 的敏感性随介质不同——sed1 随 K 从 16→256 单调提升（0.591→0.720），rock2/soil2 在 K=32/16 达峰后回落，K=128 为跨数据集折中，极端取值方差大。【案例】异常分数图显示 T2 的高分区更集中于矿点集群而非散布区，空间结构更平滑、地质连贯性更好，DTD 更小、AP 与 PR-AUC 具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过开放数据集 GeoChemAD 与统一基准，首次为无监督 GAD 提供了可复现、跨区域/跨介质/跨元素/跨尺度的评测平台，填补了该领域标准化基准资源的空白；并表明学习"空间上下文 + 元素依赖"的自监督 Transformer 表征优于统计、经典 ML 与常规生成/Transformer 基线，能同时提升异常检测精度与空间定位意义，为 AI 驱动的矿产勘查提供了可复现的基础与研究起点。作者同时指出局限：模型性能仍高度依赖数据集特性（特定地质条件下 AE 等基线可能更优），最优预处理策略（闭合变换、特征选择、插值）随数据与架构而变，需进一步提高跨场景鲁棒性。

title: RXNRECer Enables Fine-grained Enzymatic Function Annotation through Active Learning and Protein Language Models
summary: A key challenge in enzyme annotation is identifying the biochemical reactions catalyzed by proteins. Most existing methods rely on Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers as intermediaries: they first predict an EC number and then retrieve the associated reactions. This indirect strategy introduces ambiguity due to the complex many-to-many mappings among proteins, EC numbers, and reactions, and is further complicated by frequent updates to EC numbers and inconsistencies across databases. To address these challenges, we present RXNRECer, a transformer-based ensemble framework that directly predicts enzyme-catalyzed reactions without relying on EC numbers. It integrates protein language modeling and active learning to capture both high-level sequence semantics and fine-grained transformation patterns. Evaluations on curated cross-validation and temporal test sets demonstrate consistent improvements over six EC-based baselines, with gains of 16.54% in F1 score and 15.43% in accuracy. Beyond accuracy gains, the framework offers clear advantages for downstream applications, including scalable proteome-wide reaction annotation, enhanced specificity in refining generic reaction schemas, systematic annotation of previously uncurated proteins, and reliable identification of enzyme promiscuity. By incorporating large language models, it also provides interpretable rationales for predictions. These capabilities make RXNRECer a robust and versatile solution for EC-free, fine-grained enzyme function prediction, with potential applications across multiple areas of enzyme research and industrial applications.

AI.tldr: RXNRECer是一种无需EC号的Transformer集成框架，直接预测酶催化反应，整合蛋白质语言建模和主动学习，在F1和准确率上分别提升16.54%和15.43%，并提供可解释推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖EC号作为中介预测酶催化反应，但蛋白质、EC号和反应之间存在复杂的多对多映射关系，且EC号频繁更新和数据库不一致导致间接策略产生歧义。
AI.method: 提出RXNRECer，一个基于Transformer的集成框架，直接预测酶催化反应而不依赖EC号。框架整合了蛋白质语言建模和主动学习，以捕获高级序列语义和细粒度转换模式。
AI.result: 在交叉验证和时间测试集上的评估表明，RXNRECer相比六个基于EC的基线方法表现一致提升，F1分数提高16.54%，准确率提高15.43%。
AI.conclusion: RXNRECer是一个无需EC号的鲁棒且多功能的酶功能预测框架，结合蛋白质语言模型和主动学习，在F1分数和准确率上分别提升了16.54%和15.43%，具有可解释性推理能力，适用于蛋白质组规模反应注释、反应模式细化等功能预测。

title: BoSS: A Best-of-Strategies Selector as an Oracle for Deep Active Learning
summary: Active learning (AL) aims to reduce annotation costs while maximizing model performance by iteratively selecting valuable instances. While foundation models have made it easier to identify these instances, existing selection strategies still lack robustness across different models, annotation budgets, and datasets. To highlight the potential weaknesses of existing AL strategies and provide a reference point for research, we explore oracle strategies, i.e., strategies that approximate the optimal selection by accessing ground-truth information unavailable in practical AL scenarios. Current oracle strategies, however, fail to scale effectively to large datasets and complex deep neural networks. To tackle these limitations, we introduce the Best-of-Strategy Selector (BoSS), a scalable oracle strategy designed for large-scale AL scenarios. BoSS constructs a set of candidate batches through an ensemble of selection strategies and then selects the batch yielding the highest performance gain. As an ensemble of selection strategies, BoSS can be easily extended with new state-of-the-art strategies as they emerge, ensuring it remains a reliable oracle strategy in the future. Our evaluation demonstrates that i) BoSS outperforms existing oracle strategies, ii) state-of-the-art AL strategies still fall noticeably short of oracle performance, especially in large-scale datasets with many classes, and iii) one possible solution to counteract the inconsistent performance of AL strategies might be to employ an ensemble-based approach for the selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Best-of-Strategies Selector（BoSS）——一种可扩展到大规模数据集与复杂深度神经网络的“批量级”oracle 主动学习（AL）策略。其做法是：先用多种现有SOTA选择策略的集成构造候选批次集合，再冻结预训练骨干、仅重训练最后一层线性头来评估各候选批次的性能增益，最后选取增益最高者。BoSS在10个图像数据集（附4个文本数据集）上全面超越CDO、SAS等已有oracle策略，并显著优于所有可实际使用的SOTA选择策略（如BADGE、TypiClust、DropQuery、FastBAIT等），在ImageNet等大规模多类任务上差距尤为突出。论文同时表明：没有任何单一策略能在所有周期/数据集上占优，集成式AL是重要方向。作者明确指出oracle不可作为可达上界，差距应视为“改进潜力”的参考而非直接可获收益。
AI.motivation: 深度主动学习（AL）中，样本选择策略是决定标注效率的关键环节，但已有研究一致表明：没有任何单一策略能在不同模型、数据集和标注预算下稳定占优（Munjal et al., 2022；Lüth et al., 2024；Werner et al., 2024），且大多数策略依赖“不确定性/代表性”等启发式代理，与最终性能提升之间缺乏直接联系。此外，单实例贪心选择（如Roy & McCallum, 2001；Zhou et al., 2021的模拟退火oracle、Werner et al., 2024的CDO）因组合爆炸与逐次重训练开销，无法扩展到ImageNet级别的大规模多类任务，因此无法作为诊断SOTA策略“距离最优有多远”的参照基准。为提供可靠的研究参考点，需要一个可扩展、批量化、性能导向的oracle策略。
AI.method: 1）形式化：将AL建模为监督子集选择问题，定义批量获取的最优目标 B* = argmin_{B⊆U} E[ℓ(y, p(y|x, L+))]，相比逐实例贪心（Eq.2）更具非贪心性质并能捕捉实例的长期影响。2）候选批次选择（Algorithm 1）：对集成策略集合 S={Random, Margin, CoreSets, BADGE, FastBAIT, TypiClust, AlfaMix, DropQuery} 及两个使用标签聚类的变体（TypiClust*、DropQuery*），每个策略生成 T̂=⌊T/|S|⌋=10 个候选批次；通过对随机采样子池 C⊂U（大小 k~Unif{b..k_max}）施加策略，使确定性策略也能产生多样批次并控制计算/内存开销，同时以性能评估兜底低质量候选。3）性能估计：oracle性质允许直接使用测试集 E 作为评估集，损失采用零一损失（亦可用Brier score/交叉熵）。4）重训练：采用 selection-via-proxy（Coleman et al., 2020），冻结特征提取器 φ、仅重训练最后线性层 θ，评估阶段用50 epoch（选择后正式训练为200 epoch），显著降低开销并提升估计稳定性。5）复杂度：O(T·train-eval)，重训练频率与批大小b和循环数A无关，优于CDO的O(m·Σ train-eval)（m=20，b=100即需2000次重训练，样本量随b平方增长）和SAS的O((s+g)·A·train-eval)。6）实验设置：10个图像数据集（CIFAR-10至ImageNet，K=10~1000，批大小10~1000），20个AL循环，10次试验重复，骨干为DINOv2-ViT-S/14与SwinV2-B，报告相对学习曲线与AULC；并做候选批次来源、批大小、损失函数、重训练epoch、策略数量等消融。
AI.result: i) 在等算力对齐条件下，BoSS在CIFAR-10/Snacks/Dopanim/DTD上匹配或超过CDO与SAS（CIFAR-10与Snacks相对随机采样提升约20%，Dopanim与DTD约10%）；SAS因搜索步数被大幅削减仅带来边际增益。ii) 在所有数据集与所有循环上，BoSS一致优于SOTA可实施策略，ImageNet上DINOv2下其精度提升约为最佳策略的两倍；差距与数据集复杂度正相关（大规模多类场景差距最大），且策略表现随骨干模型变化（DINOv2上接近oracle的策略在SwinV2上差距变大），说明缺少模型无关的鲁棒策略。iii) 策略被选频率分析：早期由带监督聚类的DropQuery*、TypiClust*主导（表征性/探索），中后期BAIT等不确定性策略被选，末期Random被频繁选中（说明当前策略在 exploitation 阶段失效），不存在单一策略通吃；每策略数量增加带来AULC提升（每策略1→10批：AULC 89.90→90.70 / 70.45→71.79），超10批收益可忽略；损失函数（零一/交叉熵/Brier）差异很小，交叉熵略低；50 epoch重训练与200 epoch全量几乎等效。iv) 文本任务（AGNews、DBPedia、Banking、Clinc，MiniLM特征）上同样验证有效。v) 消融显示监督的贡献随数据集与阶段变化：CIFAR-10上无监督变体与近似监督变体即可达到同等水平，而CIFAR-100/Food101中监督策略在早期作用明显；域偏移大的DTD上近似监督因偶然不确定性导致标签错误而性能退化。
AI.conclusion: BoSS是首个可扩展至大规模数据集与复杂DNN的批量AL oracle，它通过“策略集成构造候选批次 + 仅重训练末层的性能评估 + 选最高增益批次”三条机制实现了对最优选择的可处理近似。核心结论有三：其一，SOTA AL策略与oracle之间仍存在明显差距，差距在大规模多类任务中最大，说明该方向仍有较大改进空间；其二，oracle不应被解读为可达上界，其差距可分解为“现有策略的固有缺陷”与“监督信息本身带来的不可达优势”两部分，二者的原则性分解仍是开放问题；其三，由于没有单一策略在所有数据集与所有AL周期内占优，未来AL研究应更重视集成式策略——可自适应地按周期选择最合适策略，例如将策略间预算分配建模为多臂老虎机问题，并通过候选批次相似度度量冗余、鼓励更独立的策略。作者建议：新策略发表时可直接将其并入BoSS集成并附带若干已实现的对比策略，构建标准化的oracle基准（实现开源于 github.com/dhuseljic/dal-toolbox）。

title: MXNorm: Reusing MXFP block scales for efficient tensor normalisation
summary: Matrix multiplication performance has long been the major bottleneck to scaling deep learning workloads, which has stimulated the design of new accelerators that use increasingly low-precision number formats. However, improvements in matrix multiplication performance have far outstripped improvements in performance on reductions and elementwise computations, which are still being performed in higher precision. In this work, we propose MXNorm, a drop-in replacement for RMSNorm that estimates the RMS using only the block scales calculated as part of the MXFP8 cast and enables a 32x decrease in the size of reduction needed for normalization. We validate our approximation method on pre-training of Llama 3 models of 125M, 1B and 8B parameters, finding minimal loss of training accuracy compared to a baseline using RMSNorm with MXFP8 matmuls. We also show practical kernel speedups using only torch.compile of up to 2.4x for MXNorm over RMSNorm, corresponding to a 1.3% speedup in Llama 3 8B transformer layers in MXFP8 and a 2.6% speedup in NVFP4.

AI.tldr: MXNorm是一种用于深度学习的新型归一化方法，作为RMSNorm的替代品，它利用MXFP8 cast过程中计算的块尺度来估计RMS，使归一化所需的约简操作减少32倍，在Llama 3模型（125M、1B、8B）预训练中验证了可行性，获得最高2.4x的内核加速。
AI.motivation: 矩阵乘法性能是深度学习扩展的主要瓶颈，尽管低精度格式（如MXFP8）显著提升了矩阵乘法性能，但归约和逐元素计算（如RMSNorm）仍需更高精度执行，导致计算瓶颈从矩阵乘法转移到归约操作。
AI.method: 提出MXNorm，利用MXFP8 cast过程中已计算的块尺度（block scales）来估计RMS值，无需对全部张量进行完整归约，从而将归一化所需的归约大小减少32倍。
AI.result: 在Llama 3 125M、1B和8B参数模型的预训练中验证，与使用RMSNorm+MXFP8矩阵乘法的基线相比，训练精度损失极小。使用torch.compile实现MXNorm，最高获得2.4x的内核加速，对应于MXFP8格式下Llama 3 8B transformer层1.3%的端到端加速，NVFP4格式下2.6%的加速。
AI.conclusion: MXNorm可作为RMSNorm的有效替代方案，在低精度训练场景（MXFP8、NVFP4等）下以极低精度损失换取显著性能提升，解决了低精度矩阵乘法与传统归一化操作之间的性能不平衡问题。

title: SciDesignBench: Benchmarking and Improving Language Models for Scientific Inverse Design
summary: Many of the most important problems in science and engineering are inverse problems: given a desired outcome, find a design that achieves it. Evaluating whether a candidate meets the spec is often routine; a binding energy can be computed, a reactor yield simulated, a pharmacokinetic profile predicted. But searching a combinatorial design space for inputs that satisfy those targets is fundamentally harder. We introduce SciDesignBench, a benchmark of 520 simulator-grounded tasks across 14 scientific domains and five settings spanning single-shot design, short-horizon feedback, long-horizon refinement, and seed-design optimization. On the 10-domain shared-core subset, the best zero-shot model reaches only 29.0% success despite substantially higher parse rates. Simulator feedback helps, but the leaderboard changes with horizon: Sonnet 4.5 is strongest in one-turn de novo design, whereas Opus 4.6 is strongest after 20 turns of simulator-grounded refinement. Providing a starting seed design reshuffles the leaderboard again, demonstrating that constrained modification requires a fundamentally different capability from unconstrained de novo generation. We then introduce RLSF, a simulator-feedback training recipe. An RLSF-tuned 8B model raises single-turn success rates by 8-17 percentage points across three domains. Together, these results position simulator-grounded inverse design as both a benchmark for scientific reasoning and a practical substrate for amortizing expensive test-time compute into model weights.

AI.tldr: SciDesignBench是一个包含520个模拟器grounding任务的基准，涵盖14个科学领域，用于评估基于模拟器的逆向设计能力。最佳零样本模型成功率为29%，模拟器反馈有帮助但效果有限，模型在不同设置下表现各异，RLSF训练可显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 科学和工程中的许多最重要问题都是逆问题：给定期望结果，找到实现它的设计。评估候选是否满足规格通常很简单，但在组合设计空间中搜索满足目标的输入本质上更加困难。
AI.method: 提出了SciDesignBench基准，包含520个模拟器 grounding 任务，涵盖14个科学领域和5种设置（单轮设计、短视野反馈、长视野优化、种子设计优化）。同时提出了RLSF（模拟器反馈强化学习）训练方法。
AI.result: 在10领域共享核心子集上，最佳零样本模型仅达到29.0%的成功率。模拟器反馈有帮助，但排行榜随视野变化：Sonnet 4.5在单轮de novo设计中最强，Opus 4.6在20轮模拟器优化后最强。提供种子设计重新洗牌排行榜，证明约束性修改需要与无约束de novo生成根本不同的能力。RLSF-tune的8B模型在三个领域的单轮成功率提升了8-17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 基于模拟器的逆向设计既是科学推理的基准，也是将昂贵的测试时计算 amortized 到模型权重中的实际基础。RLSF-tune的8B模型在三个领域的单轮成功率提升了8-17个百分点。

title: Learnability and Privacy Vulnerability are Entangled in a Few Critical Weights
summary: Prior approaches for membership privacy preservation usually update or retrain all weights in neural networks, which is costly and can lead to unnecessary utility loss or even more serious misalignment in predictions between training data and non-training data. In this work, we observed three insights: i) privacy vulnerability exists in a very small fraction of weights; ii) however, most of those weights also critically impact utility performance; iii) the importance of weights stems from their locations rather than their values. According to these insights, to preserve privacy, we score critical weights, and instead of discarding those neurons, we rewind only the weights for fine-tuning. We show that, through extensive experiments, this mechanism exhibits outperforming resilience in most cases against Membership Inference Attacks while maintaining utility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经网络中的权重级成员隐私脆弱性，发现隐私风险只集中于极小部分权重，且这些权重与决定模型效用的关键权重高度重叠；更重要的是，权重的"可学习性"取决于其位置而非取值。据此提出 CWRF（Critical Weights Rewinding and Finetuning）：用机器遗忘目标估计每个权重的隐私脆弱性分数，将高风险权重回滚（rewind）至初始化值并冻结，其余权重在隐私训练目标下微调，从而在保持精度的同时显著降低 LiRA/RMIA 成员推断攻击的成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有成员隐私防御（DP-SGD、RelaxLoss、HAMP、CCL、PAST）通常需从头训练或更新全部权重，成本高、可能带来额外效用损失，并可能加剧训练/非训练样本之间的预测失配；而已有基于剪枝的隐私缓解工作（Yuan & Zhang 2022）被证明无效。作者提出反思性问题：是否存在仅少数权重，其更新就导致隐私泄露？为此需要先在权重级别定位隐私脆弱性，并厘清其与效用（可学习性）的关系。
AI.method:
1) 隐私脆弱性估计：借鉴机器遗忘，构造未保护模型 M_up（训练于 D_tr）与 vanilla 模型 M_vn（初始化参数），在成员数据上最小化交叉熵、在非成员数据 D_re 上最小化与 M_vn 输出的 KL 散度，得到 L_pve=(1-λ)L_ce+λL_kl；沿该过程的梯度与权重幅值累积得到权重级隐私脆弱性分数（Eq.2/4）。
2) 纠缠性分析：将隐私脆弱性分数与 TFO 类可学习性分数（|g·w|）在 ResNet18 与 ViT 上按层类型（Conv/Att+MLP、Linear、Norm）可视化并计算 Pearson 相关系数。
3) CWRF 三步法：(i) 估计隐私脆弱性分数 S_pve；(ii) 取 Top-r 分数权重构成回滚掩码 B_r，其余为冻结掩码 B_f，将 B_r 位置权重由 θ_up 回滚至初始化值 θ_vn（θ_rw=B_f⊙θ_up+B_r⊙θ_vn）；(iii) 冻结权重（用梯度掩码实现）并对剩余权重施用任意隐私训练方法做微调，同时学习率也回滚到初始值（类似 LRR）。
4) 假设验证：设计 M1/M2/M3（未剪、85%剪枝+回滚重训、85%剪枝不重训）与 A1（删除隐私权重+微调不脆弱权重）、A2（回滚+微调脆弱权重）、A3=CWRF（回滚+微调不脆弱权重）消融对比。
AI.result:
1) 按 TFO 剪枝到 90% 稀疏度时精度仍保持，但隐私风险未改善甚至更差（测试损失上升），说明剪除不关键权重无效。
2) 隐私脆弱性与可学习性高度相关：ResNet18 全体 PCC=0.8329、Conv 0.9410；ViT 全体 0.7667、Att+MLP 0.9068；归一化层权重占比<1% 但部分为高隐私风险权重，其 PCC 最低（0.6776/0.7336）。Transformer 的隐私脆弱性整体高于 CNN。
3) 位置假设成立：删除（而非回滚）隐私脆弱权重导致精度不可恢复的崩溃（A1），回滚并保留位置则可恢复（A2/A3）；CWRF(A3) 在 0.1%–5% 回滚比例下的训练/测试损失差距显著优于 A2 与从头训练（如 3% 时 A3 test loss 0.8044 vs 从头训练 1.5398）。
4) 与防御方法组合后普遍提升隐私-效用权衡：CIFAR-10 上 ResNet18 RelaxLoss+CWRF 的 LiRA AUC 由 70.51% 降至 68.31%、TPR@FPR 1e-3 由 1.38% 降至 0.03%；HAMP+CWRF 精度反而从 77.79% 升至 81.43%；ViT 上 CCL+CWRF 的 LiRA AUC 降至 0.00、RMIA AUC 由 56.33% 降至 51.32%。CINIC-10 上 HAMP+CWRF 最佳；CIFAR-100 上 HAMP 单独训练不收敛但配合 CWRF 可获得更好效用。128 个影子模型、DBpedia-14 NLP（transformer）与隐私-效用曲线实验均显示一致优势。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：隐私脆弱性与可学习性纠缠在极少数权重上，且权重的重要性来自其位置而非取值，因此不能靠剪枝解决成员隐私问题；正确做法是回滚（而非删除）隐私高风险权重至初始化、冻结它们，再对剩余权重做隐私定向微调。CWRF 是首个权重级别的成员隐私微调策略，可在多数情形下超越从头训练的隐私防御方法的隐私-效用权衡，并能提升训练稳定性、避免模型坍塌。作者同时指出其局限：仅当所用隐私训练方法本身有效时才能带来增益（如 RelaxLoss 与 RMIA 组合稳定性差，CCL 在 RMIA 上偶有退化），且未来需研究数据端方法与定位隐私风险起源层的关系。

title: PhysMoDPO: Physically-Plausible Humanoid Motion with Preference Optimization
summary: Recent progress in text-conditioned human motion generation has been largely driven by diffusion models trained on large-scale human motion data. Building on this progress, recent methods attempt to transfer such models for character animation and real robot control by applying a Whole-Body Controller (WBC) that converts diffusion-generated motions into executable trajectories. While WBC trajectories become compliant with physics, they may expose substantial deviations from original motion. To address this issue, we here propose PhysMoDPO, a Direct Preference Optimization framework. Unlike prior work that relies on hand-crafted physics-aware heuristics such as foot-sliding penalties, we integrate WBC into our training pipeline and optimize diffusion model such that the output of WBC becomes compliant both with physics and original text instructions. To train PhysMoDPO we deploy physics-based and task-specific rewards and use them to assign preference to synthesized trajectories. Our extensive experiments on text-to-motion and spatial control tasks demonstrate consistent improvements of PhysMoDPO in both physical realism and task-related metrics on simulated robots. Moreover, we demonstrate that PhysMoDPO results in significant improvements when applied to zero-shot motion transfer in simulation and for real-world deployment on a G1 humanoid robot.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysMoDPO框架，通过将全身控制器(WBC)集成到训练管道中，并使用基于物理的奖励进行直接偏好优化（DPO），解决了扩散模型生成的运动在经过WBC转换后偏离原始运动的问题，实现了G1人形机器人的零样本运动迁移和真实世界部署。
AI.motivation: 现有方法使用全身控制器(WBC)将扩散模型生成的运动转换为可执行轨迹时，WBC轨迹虽符合物理但可能与原始运动产生显著偏差，之前依赖于手工设计的物理感知启发式方法（如脚滑 penalty）效果有限。
AI.method: 提出PhysMoDPO框架，将WBC集成到训练管道中，利用基于物理的奖励和任务特定奖励来分配偏好，训练扩散模型使其输出的WBC结果同时符合物理约束和原始文本指令。
AI.result: 在文本到运动和空间控制任务上，PhysMoDPO在物理真实性和任务相关指标上均取得一致提升；在模拟中实现零样本运动迁移，并在G1人形机器人上成功进行真实世界部署。
AI.conclusion: PhysMoDPO通过将WBC集成到训练管道中，使用基于物理的奖励来分配偏好，显著提高了生成运动在物理真实性和任务相关指标上的表现，并在G1人形机器人上成功实现了零样本运动迁移和真实世界部署。

title: Upper Bounds for Local Learning Coefficients of Three-Layer Neural Networks
summary:
Three-layer neural networks are known to form singular learning models, and their Bayesian asymptotic behavior is governed by the learning coefficient, or real log canonical threshold. Although this quantity has been clarified for regular models and for some special singular models, broadly applicable methods for evaluating it in neural networks remain limited.
  Recently, a formula for the local learning coefficient of semiregular models was proposed, yielding an upper bound on the learning coefficient. However, this formula applies only to nonsingular points in the set of realization parameters and cannot be used at singular points. In particular, for three-layer neural networks, the resulting upper bound has been shown to differ substantially from learning coefficient values already known in some cases.
  In this paper, we derive an upper-bound formula for the local learning coefficient at singular points in three-layer neural networks. This formula can be interpreted as a counting rule under budget constraints and demand-supply constraints, and is applicable to general analytic activation functions. In particular, it covers the swish function and polynomial functions, extending previous results to a wider class of activation functions.
  We further show that, when the input dimension is one, the upper bound obtained here coincides with the already known learning coefficient, thereby partially resolving the discrepancy above. Our result also provides a systematic perspective on how the weight parameters of three-layer neural networks affect the learning coefficient.

AI.tldr: 本文针对三层神经网络这一奇异学习模型，推导出一个可在奇异实现参数处直接使用的局部学习系数（实对数规范阈值）上界公式。该公式由六个量（Fisher信息秩r、输出侧退化权重数α、输入侧退化权重数β、项组数γ、各组最低阶m_s及各组线性无关随机变量数n_s）显式给出，可解释为"预算—需求—供给"约束下的计数规则（货架选购问题）。该上界适用于一般实解析激活函数（含 swish、tanh 等），并在多项式激活情形下（真分布无隐藏单元）成立，从而把先前仅适用于半正则模型非奇异点的结果推广到奇异点。
AI.motivation: 三层神经网络是典型的奇异学习模型：Fisher信息矩阵可能不正定，AIC/BIC无法直接用于模型选择，其贝叶斯渐近行为由Watanabe的奇异学习理论中的学习系数（实对数规范阈值）刻画。Kurumadani此前针对半正则模型给出了非奇异实现参数处的局部学习系数公式，并由此得到三层神经网络学习系数的上界，但该公式无法用于奇异实现参数，且在若干已知案例中与已有精确值差异显著（例如降秩回归中 d²/2 与 3d²/8 的差距）。因此需要在奇异点上建立可广泛适用的上界公式，既为模型选择与复杂度评估提供理论参照，也可用于校验数值估计的LLC（局部学习系数）指标。
AI.method: 核心是一般性"主定理"：设定统计模型含 r+α+β 个参数（θ,a,b），原点为实现参数；设对数似然比函数在 (θ=0,a,b) 处的泰勒展开可分解为 ∑_s∑_n g_{s,n}(a,b)Z_{s,n} + ∑_s h_s(a,b)W_s，其中 g_{s,n} 关于 b 的最低次数为 m_s，且满足 (i) g_{s,n}(0,·)=0、(ii) ∂ḡ/∂a 在 a=0 处存在 b≠0 使秩为 ∑_{s≤L}n_s^*、(iii) 随机变量线性无关、(iv) h_s 落在 (g_{s,n})² 所生成的理想中。由此给出上界 λ_P ≤ r/2 + {β/(2m₁), [β+∑(m_{K+1}-m_s)n_s^*]/(2m_{K+1}), ∑n_s^*/2}，其中 K 由预算 β 决定、L 由需求 α 决定。证明用代数几何的解奇异方法：分四步（m₁ 次爆破 → 依条件(ii)作 a↦a' 坐标变换 → 各阶段 m_{k+1}-m_k 次爆破 → 关于 (θ,a) 的一次爆破）得到法交叉形式，由 Jacobian 行列式幂次计算各候选值并取最小。应用到三层网络 Y=Aσ(BX)+N：非多项式解析情形在 P₁（冗余隐藏单元权重全零）与 P₂（N=1，输入权重并联于真实单元）两个实现参数处给出显式上界；σ(x)=x 归约为降秩回归；一般多项式情形在 H*=0 时给出上界。另附引理（B.3/B.4：单项式因子可从 f 提取、平方后从 K 提取）、Lemma A.2（广义 Vandermonde 矩阵非奇异）、Prop A.1（输入分布绝对连续、b_i*≠0 且互不为 ±、σ 非多项式时线性无关条件成立）及附录 C 的具体算例（N=1,H=4,M=1,σ=tanh，得 λ_P≤11/6）。
AI.result: (1) 主定理给出在奇异实现参数处的通用上界，可解释为"在货架数γ、需求α、预算β、单价m_s、库存n_s 约束下最多能购买的最大件数（允许分数）"；并给出单调性：单价升高使上界变小、库存增加使上界变大、插入空货架不影响结果。(2) 非多项式解析激活函数（如 swish、tanh、exp(x)-1、x/(1+e^{-x}) 等）的一般情形下，三层网络在 P₁ 处的上界为 (M+N)H*/2 加三分支项；N=1 时 P₂ 处上界给出另一三分支表达式，取两者最小即整体学习系数上界。(3) 一致性：N=1 时右端数值与 Aoyagi[3] 的已知精确学习系数完全吻合（部分消除了此前的数值差异）；N≥2 时上界可严格不等——降秩回归中 N=M=H=d≥2、R=0 时上界为 d²/2，而真实学习系数为 3d²/8（d 偶）或 (3d²+1)/8（d 奇），即主定理不等式可为严格。(4) 线性情形 σ(x)=x 的上界与 Aoyagi[9] 的 Cases 2–4 一致，但 Case 1 未能由本方法得到。(5) 表1 汇总了各情形下 r,α,β,γ,m_s,n_s 的具体取值；Remark 3.2 指出 r+α+β 不等于参数总数，暗示存在"冗余参数"不参与结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出了三层神经网络局部学习系数在奇异点的普适上界公式，把此前仅适用于半正则模型非奇异点的结果推广到奇异点，并将适用范围从特殊激活函数扩展到一般实解析激活函数（含 swish），在多项式情形下于"真分布无隐藏单元"的限制下亦成立；N=1 时该上界恰为已知精确学习系数，部分解决了此前上界与已知值差异明显的问题，并系统揭示了权重参数（尤其冗余隐藏单元的输出侧/输入侧权重数）对学习系数的作用机制。局限与未来工作：主定理要求条件(ii)的秩条件在 b≠0 处成立，若存在秩退化点则只能得到上界，需进一步分析这些退化点以给出更紧上界或等号成立条件；多项式激活且真分布含隐藏单元（H*>0）的情形尚待系统处理；方法可推广至三层以上的深度网络；并需通过实验检验这些上界在模型比较与模型选择中的实用价值。

title: A Fractional Fox H-Function Kernel for Support Vector Machines: Robust Classification via Weighted Transmutation Operators
summary: Support Vector Machines (SVMs) rely heavily on the choice of the kernel function to map data into high-dimensional feature spaces. While the Gaussian Radial Basis Function (RBF) is the industry standard, its exponential decay makes it highly susceptible to structural noise and outliers, often leading to severe overfitting in complex datasets. In this paper, we propose a novel class of non-stationary kernels derived from the fundamental solution of the generalized time-space fractional diffusion-wave equation. By leveraging a structure-preserving transmutation method over Weighted Sobolev Spaces, we introduce the Fox-Dorrego Kernel, an exact analytical Mercer kernel governed by the Fox H-function. Unlike standard kernels, our formulation incorporates an aging weight function (the "Amnesia Effect") to penalize distant outliers and a fractional asymptotic power-law decay to allow for robust, heavy-tailed feature mapping (analogous to Lévy flights). Numerical experiments on both synthetic datasets and real-world high-dimensional radar data (Ionosphere) demonstrate that the proposed Fox-Dorrego kernel consistently outperforms the standard Gaussian RBF baseline, reducing the classification error rate by approximately 50\% while maintaining structural robustness against outliers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于广义时间-空间分数阶扩散波方程基本解的新型非平稳核函数——Fox-Dorrego核。该核由Fox H函数刻画，通过加权Sobolev空间上的结构保持变换方法构造，并引入"遗忘效应"惩罚远距离异常点及分数阶幂律衰减实现鲁棒的 Lévy 飞行特征映射。在合成数据集和Ionosphere雷达数据上的实验表明，该方法相比Gaussian RBF基线可将分类错误率降低约50%。
AI.motivation: 标准Gaussian RBF核的指数衰减特性使其对结构噪声和异常值高度敏感，在复杂数据集上容易导致严重过拟合问题。
AI.method: 基于广义时间-空间分数阶扩散波方程的基本解，利用加权Sobolev空间上的结构保持变换方法，推导出由Fox H函数精确解析表示的Mercer核函数。该核函数引入"遗忘效应"(Amnesia Effect)权重函数惩罚远距离异常点，并采用分数阶渐近幂律衰减实现类似Lévy飞行的鲁棒特征映射。
AI.result: 在合成数据集和真实高维雷达数据(Ionosphere)上的数值实验表明，提出的Fox-Dorrego核相比标准Gaussian RBF基线可降低约50%的分类错误率，同时对异常点保持结构鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: Fox-Dorrego核作为一种新型非平稳核函数，能够有效处理复杂数据集中的噪声和异常值问题，为SVM分类提供了有前景的替代方案。

title: A Multi-task Large Reasoning Model for Molecular Science
summary: Advancements in artificial intelligence for molecular science are necessitating a paradigm shift from purely data-driven predictions to knowledge-guided computational reasoning. Existing molecular models are predominantly proprietary, lacking general molecular intelligence and generalizability. This underscores the necessity for computational methods that can effectively integrate scientific logic with deep learning architectures. Here we introduce a multi-task large reasoning model designed to emulate the cognitive processes of molecular scientists through structured reasoning and reflection. Our approach incorporates multi-specialist modules to provide versatile molecular expertise and a chain-of-thought (CoT) framework enhanced by reinforcement learning infused with molecular knowledge, enabling structured and reflective reasoning. Systematic evaluations across 10 molecular tasks and 47 metrics demonstrate that our model achieves an average 50.3% improvement over the base architecture, outperforming over 20 state-of-the-art baselines, including ultra-large-parameter foundation models, despite using significantly fewer training data and computational resources. This validates that embedding explicit reasoning mechanisms enables high-efficiency learning, allowing smaller-scale models to surpass massive counterparts in both efficacy and interpretability. The practical utility of this computational framework was validated through a case study on the design of central nervous system (CNS) drug candidates, illustrating its capacity to bridge data-driven and knowledge-integrated approaches for intelligent molecular design.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多任务大型推理模型，通过多专家模块和融入分子知识的强化学习增强思维链框架，实现结构化反思推理。在10个分子任务上平均提升50.3%，超越20多个SOTA基线，验证了显式推理机制使小规模模型可超越大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 现有分子模型多为专有模型，缺乏通用分子智能和泛化能力。AI进展需要从纯数据驱动预测向知识引导的计算推理范式转变，需要有效整合科学逻辑与深度学习架构的方法。
AI.method: 提出多任务大型推理模型，包含：1) 多专家模块提供多样化分子专业知识；2) 融入分子知识的强化学习增强思维链(CoT)框架，实现结构化反思推理。
AI.result: 在10个分子任务和47个指标上系统性评估，模型平均提升50.3%，超越20多个SOTA基线（包括超大规模参数基础模型），同时使用更少训练数据和计算资源。
AI.conclusion: 通过嵌入显式推理机制实现高效学习，使较小规模模型在性能和可解释性上超越大规模模型。框架在CNS药物设计案例中得到验证，成功弥合了数据驱动与知识集成方法之间的差距，为智能分子设计提供了新范式。

title: On Linear Separability of the MNIST Handwritten Digits Dataset
summary: The MNIST dataset containing thousands of handwritten digit images is still a fundamental benchmark for evaluating various pattern-recognition and image-classification models. Linear separability is a key concept in many statistical and machine-learning techniques. Despite the long history of the MNIST dataset and its relative simplicity in size and resolution, the question of whether the dataset is linearly separable has never been fully answered -- scientific and informal sources share conflicting claims. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive empirical investigation to address this question, distinguishing pairwise and one-vs-rest separation of the training, the test and the combined sets, respectively. It reviews the theoretical approaches to assessing linear separability, alongside state-of-the-art methods and tools, then systematically examines all relevant assemblies, and reports the findings.

AI.tldr: 本文对MNIST数据集的线性可分性进行了全面的实证研究，通过系统检验训练集、测试集及组合集的成对分离和一对一分离方式，结合理论方法与先进工具，验证了关于线性可分性的争议性claims。
AI.motivation: MNIST数据集作为手写数字识别的基础基准，尽管其规模较小且分辨率相对简单，但关于该数据集是否线性可分的问题一直存在争议，从未得到完整解答。
AI.method: 回顾线性可分性评估的理论方法，结合最先进的工具和方法，系统性地检验所有相关集合（训练集、测试集及组合集）的成对分离和一对一分离情况。
AI.result: 报告了针对训练集、测试集及组合集进行成对和一对一分离的实证发现。
AI.conclusion: 提供了关于MNIST数据集线性可分性的全面实证研究结论，为该长期争议问题提供了明确的实验证据。

title: Test-time RL alignment exposes task familiarity artifacts in LLM benchmarks
summary: Direct evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks can be misleading because comparatively strong performance may reflect task familiarity rather than capability. The train-before-test approach controls for task familiarity by giving each model task-relevant training before evaluation, originally through supervised finetuning. However, suitable training data is often hard to come by, and evaluation results vary with the data chosen. In this paper, we propose a two-stage test-time reinforcement learning (RL) alignment method for train-before-test. First, RL with a single sample provides a first alignment of the model to the task format, and second, test-time RL with majority-voting reward aligns the model to the benchmark distribution. Our test-time RL alignment method aligns similarly well as SFT-based train-before test, but without requiring a task-specific training set. On a domain-specific benchmark without training data, we show that direct evaluation underestimates base models which perform substantially better once aligned, yielding a more faithful evaluation of their capabilities. Moreover, for reasoning tasks, the performance gap between fine-tuned models and their base models largely disappears after alignment, suggesting that many gains from RLVR/SFT reported in the literature are not a difference in reasoning capability, but rather artifacts of task familiarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两阶段测试时RL对齐方法替代SFT进行train-before-test评估，无需任务特定训练数据即可实现有效对齐。研究发现直接评估会低估基础模型能力，且微调模型与基础模型的推理性能差距主要源于任务熟悉度而非真实能力差异。
AI.motivation: 直接评估LLM可能产生误导，因为较好的表现可能反映的是任务熟悉度而非真实能力。传统的train-before-test方法通过监督微调(SFT)控制任务熟悉度，但存在两个问题：1) 难以获得合适的训练数据；2) 评估结果随数据选择而变化。
AI.method: 提出两阶段测试时强化学习(RL)对齐方法：1) 单样本RL提供任务格式的初步对齐；2) 测试时RL结合多数投票奖励将模型对齐到基准分布。
AI.result: 测试时RL对齐方法与SFT-based train-before-test对齐效果相当，但无需任务特定训练集。在无训练数据的领域特定基准上，直接评估低估了基础模型，这些模型在对齐后表现显著更好。对于推理任务，微调模型与基础模型之间的性能差距在很大程度上消失。
AI.conclusion: 文献中报道的许多RLVR/SFT收益并非推理能力的差异，而是任务熟悉度的人为产物，这为更准确地评估LLM能力提供了方法论贡献。

title: Enhanced Drug-drug Interaction Prediction Using Adaptive Knowledge Integration
summary: Drug-drug interaction event (DDIE) prediction is crucial for preventing adverse reactions and ensuring optimal therapeutic outcomes. However, existing methods often face challenges with imbalanced datasets, complex interaction mechanisms, and poor generalization to unknown drug combinations. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge augmentation framework that adaptively infuses prior drug knowledge into a large language model (LLM). This framework utilizes reinforcement learning techniques to facilitate adaptive knowledge extraction and synthesis, thereby efficiently optimizing the strategy space to enhance the accuracy of LLMs for DDIE predictions. As a result of few-shot learning, we achieved a notable improvement compared to the baseline. This approach establishes an effective framework for scientific knowledge learning for DDIE predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于知识增强和强化学习的LLM框架，用于药物-药物相互作用事件预测，通过自适应知识提取与合成解决数据集不平衡和泛化问题，少样本学习下取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临数据集不平衡、复杂交互机制以及对未知药物组合的泛化能力差等挑战，亟需一种能够有效处理这些问题的DDIE预测方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于知识增强的自适应框架，利用强化学习技术实现自适应知识提取与合成，优化策略空间以增强LLM在DDIE预测中的准确性，并采用少样本学习策略。
AI.result: 通过少样本学习，该方法取得了显著的改进效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一个有效的DDIE预测科学知识学习框架，通过知识增强和强化学习技术提升了模型的预测准确性。

title: DirPA: Addressing Prior Shift in Imbalanced Few-shot Crop-type Classification
summary: Real-world agricultural monitoring is often hampered by severe class imbalance and high label acquisition costs, resulting in significant data scarcity. In few-shot learning (FSL) -- a framework specifically designed for data-scarce settings -- , training sets are often artificially balanced. However, this creates a disconnect from the long-tailed distributions observed in nature, leading to a distribution shift that undermines the model's ability to generalize to real-world agricultural tasks. We previously introduced Dirichlet Prior Augmentation (DirPA; Reuss et al., 2026a) to proactively mitigate the effects of such label distribution skews during model training. In this work, we extend the original study's geographical scope. Specifically, we evaluate this extended approach across multiple countries in the European Union (EU), moving beyond localized experiments to test the method's resilience across diverse agricultural environments. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of DirPA across different geographical regions. We show that DirPA not only improves system robustness and stabilizes training under extreme long-tailed distributions, regardless of the target region, but also substantially improves individual class-specific performance by proactively simulating priors.

AI.tldr: 针对农业监测中类别不平衡导致的分布偏移问题，本文扩展了Dirichlet先验增强(DirPA)方法在欧盟多国的验证，证明该方法能有效提升模型在极端长尾分布下的鲁棒性和类别性能。
AI.motivation: 现实农业监测中存在严重的类别不平衡和标注成本高的问题，而少样本学习(FSL)中人工平衡训练集的做法与自然界的长尾分布存在脱节，导致分布偏移，削弱了模型在真实农业任务中的泛化能力。
AI.method: 使用Dirichlet先验增强(DirPA)方法，在模型训练过程中主动模拟标签分布的先验，以缓解标签分布偏斜对模型的影响，并在欧盟多个国家进行跨区域评估。
AI.result: DirPA在不同地理区域均表现有效，显著提升了系统鲁棒性，在极端长尾分布下稳定了训练，且通过主动模拟先验显著改善了各类别的具体性能。
AI.conclusion: DirPA在欧盟多国的跨区域验证中证明了其有效性和泛化能力，能够在极端长尾分布下稳定训练并提升各类别性能，具有较强的实际应用价值。

title: SCOPE: Semantic Coreset with Orthogonal Projection Embeddings for Federated learning
summary: Scientific discovery increasingly requires learning on federated datasets, fed by streams from high-resolution instruments, that have extreme class imbalance. Current ML approaches either require impractical data aggregation or fail due to class imbalance. Existing coreset selection methods rely on local heuristics, making them unaware of the global data landscape and prone to sub-optimal and non-representative pruning. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SCOPE (Semantic Coreset using Orthogonal Projection Embeddings for Federated learning), a coreset framework for federated data that filters anomalies and adaptively prunes redundant data to mitigate long-tail skew.
