By analyzing the latent space distribution, we score each data point using a representation score that measures the reliability of core class features, a diversity score that quantifies the novelty of orthogonal residuals, and a boundary proximity score that indicates similarity to competing classes. Unlike prior methods, SCOPE shares only scalar metrics with a federated server to construct a global consensus, ensuring communication efficiency. Guided by the global consensus, SCOPE dynamically filters local noise and discards redundant samples to counteract global feature skews. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCOPE yields competitive global accuracy and robust convergence, all while achieving exceptional efficiency with a 128x to 512x reduction in uplink bandwidth, a 7.72x wall-clock acceleration and reduced FLOP and VRAM footprints for local coreset selection.

AI.tldr: SCOPE是一个用于联邦学习的语义核心集框架，通过正交投影嵌入技术过滤异常值并自适应地修剪冗余数据，以缓解长尾偏斜问题。该方法使用三个评分指标（表示性、多样性和边界接近度）来评估数据点，仅与服务器共享标量指标以实现通信高效的全域共识。
AI.motivation: 科学发现越来越需要在极端类别不平衡的联邦数据集上进行学习。当前ML方法要么需要不切实际的数据聚合，要么因类别不平衡而失败。现有的核心集选择方法依赖局部启发式算法，无法感知全局数据分布，容易导致次优和非代表性剪枝。
AI.method: SCOPE通过分析潜在空间分布，对每个数据点进行评分：(1)表示性评分-测量核心类别特征的可靠性；(2)多样性评分-量化正交残差的 novelty；(3)边界接近度评分-指示与竞争类别的相似度。方法仅与联邦服务器共享标量指标以构建全局共识，动态过滤局部噪声并丢弃冗余样本。
AI.result: 实验表明SCOPE实现了具有竞争力的全局准确性和稳健的收敛性，同时实现了128x至512x的上行带宽减少、7.72倍时钟加速，并降低了局部核心集选择的FLOP和VRAM占用。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE通过创新的语义核心集选择方法，有效解决了联邦学习中的类别不平衡和通信效率问题，为处理长尾分布的联邦数据提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Exact Federated Continual Unlearning for Ridge Heads on Frozen Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are commonly deployed as frozen feature extractors with a small trainable head to adapt to private, user-generated data in federated settings. The ``right to be forgotten'' requires removing the influence of specific samples or users from the trained model on demand. Existing federated unlearning methods target general deep models and rely on approximate reconstruction or selective retraining, making exactness costly or elusive. We study this problem in a practically relevant but under-explored regime: a frozen foundation model with a ridge-regression head. The exact optimum depends on the data only through two additive sufficient statistics, which we turn into a communication protocol supporting an arbitrary stream of \emph{add} and \emph{delete} requests via fixed-size messages. The server maintains a head that is, in exact arithmetic, \emph{pointwise identical} to centralized retraining after every request. We provide deterministic retrain-equivalence guarantees, order and partition invariance, two server-side variants, and a Bayesian certificate of zero KL divergence. Experiments on four benchmarks confirm the guarantees: both variants match centralized ridge retraining to within $10^{-9}$ relative Frobenius error and complete each request at orders-of-

AI.tldr: 研究联邦学习场景下冻结基础模型+岭回归头的精确机器遗忘问题。通过利用加性充分统计量设计通信协议，支持任意add和delete请求流，在精确算术下实现与集中式重训练的点wise等价，同时具有顺序/分区不变性和KL零散度证书。
AI.motivation: 在联邦学习场景中，基础模型通常冻结仅作为特征提取器，配合可训练的头部适配用户数据。"被遗忘权"要求能够按需移除特定样本或用户的影响。现有的联邦遗忘方法针对通用深度模型，依靠近似重构或选择性重训练，无法精确实现且计算成本高。该研究关注实际相关但探索不足的设定：冻结的基础模型+岭回归头。
AI.method: 利用岭回归头的特殊结构，将精确最优解表示为两个加性充分统计量的函数。服务器维护一个头向量，通过固定大小的消息通信协议支持任意的add和delete请求流。提供了两种服务器端变体实现，并给出了KL散度为零的贝叶斯证书。
AI.result: 服务器维护的头部在精确算术下与每次请求后的集中式重训练逐点identical（点点相同）。两个变体的相对Frobenius误差均达到10^{-9}量级，每个请求处理速度比完整重训练快数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在精确算术下与集中式重训练完全等价，且具有顺序不变性和分区不变性。实验在四个基准数据集上验证了理论保证：两种变体的相对Frobenius误差均达到10^{-9}量级，每个请求的处理速度比完整重训练快几个数量级。

title: Retrieval-Enhanced Real Estate Appraisal
comment: Accepted at NFMCP 2024 workshop (New Frontiers in Mining Complex Patterns), held in conjunction with ECML 2024
summary: The Sales Comparison Approach (SCA) is one of the most popular when it comes to real estate appraisal. Used as a reference in real estate expertise and as one of the major types of Automatic Valuation Models (AVM), it recently gained popularity within machine learning methods. The performance of models able to use data represented as sets and graphs made it possible to adapt this methodology efficiently, yielding substantial results. SCA relies on taking past transactions (comparables) as references, selected according to their similarity with the target property's sale. In this study, we focus on the selection of these comparables for real estate appraisal. We demonstrate that the selection of comparables used in many state-of-the-art algorithms can be significantly improved by learning a selection policy instead of imposing it. Our method relies on a hybrid vector-geographical retrieval module capable of adapting to different datasets and optimized jointly with an estimation module. We further show that the use of carefully selected comparables makes it possible to build models that require fewer comparables and fewer parameters with performance close to state-of-the-art models. All our evaluations are made on five datasets which span areas in the United States, Brazil, and France.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于学习策略的可比房产选择方法，用于房地产自动评估。通过混合向量-地理检索模块与估计模块联合优化，实现了比传统预设规则更优的可比房产选择效果。
AI.motivation: 销售比较方法(SCA)在房地产评估中广泛应用，但现有最先进算法中对可比房产的选择策略通常是预设的，而非学习优化的，本文旨在改进这一选择过程。
AI.method: 采用混合向量-地理检索模块，与估计模块联合优化，通过学习选择策略来选取可比房产。
AI.result: 在覆盖美国、巴西和法国的五个数据集上的评估表明，该方法能够构建使用更少可比房产和更少参数的模型，且性能接近最先进模型。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法通过学习选择策略而非手动设定规则，显著改善了可比房产的选择效果，使模型能够使用更少的可比房产和参数达到接近最优性能水平。

title: Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding via Attention for Diffusion LLMs
summary: Parallel decoding for diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) is difficult because each denoising step provides only token-wise marginal distributions, while unmasking multiple tokens simultaneously requires accounting for inter-token dependencies. We propose Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding (DAPD), a simple, training-free decoding method that uses self-attention to induce a conditional dependency graph over masked tokens. At each iteration, edges in this graph capture strong token interactions, while non-edges indicate weak dependence. Parallel decoding is then reduced to selecting an independent set on the graph and unmasking the selected tokens in parallel. This avoids co-updating strongly coupled tokens without auxiliary models or retraining. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that DAPD improves the accuracy-steps trade-off over existing methods and enables more globally distributed parallel updates that better exploit the any-order generation capability of dLLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding (DAPD)的无训练解码方法，用于扩散大语言模型(dLLMs)的并行解码。该方法利用自注意力机制构建token依赖图，将并行解码问题转化为图上的独立集选择问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型的并行解码困难，因为每个去噪步骤仅提供token级别的边缘分布，而同时解mask多个token需要考虑token间的依赖关系。现有方法难以处理强耦合token的协同更新问题。
AI.method: 使用自注意力机制在每个迭代中构建条件依赖图，图中的边捕获强token交互，非边表示弱依赖。并行解码被简化为在图上选择独立集并并行解mask选中的token，从而避免在没有辅助模型或重训练的情况下协同更新强耦合的token。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream上的实验表明，DAPD提高了准确率与步数的权衡，并支持更全局分布的并行更新，更好地利用了dLLMs的任意顺序生成能力。
AI.conclusion: DAPD是一种简单、无训练的并行解码方法，通过依赖图感知有效地解决了扩散模型中的token协同更新问题，显著优于现有方法。

title: Deconstructing the Failure of Ideal Noise Correction: A Three-Pillar Diagnosis
summary: Statistically consistent methods based on the noise transition matrix ($T$) offer a theoretically grounded solution to Learning with Noisy Labels (LNL), with guarantees of convergence to the optimal clean-data classifier. In practice, however, these methods are often outperformed by empirical approaches such as sample selection, and this gap is usually attributed to the difficulty of accurately estimating $T$. The common assumption is that, given a perfect $T$, noise-correction methods would recover their theoretical advantage. In this work, we put this longstanding hypothesis to a decisive test. We conduct experiments under idealized conditions, providing correction methods with a perfect, oracle transition matrix. Even under these ideal conditions, we observe that these methods still suffer from performance collapse during training. This compellingly demonstrates that the failure is not fundamentally a $T$-estimation problem, but stems from a more deeply rooted flaw. To explain this behaviour, we provide a unified analysis that links three levels: macroscopic convergence states, microscopic optimisation dynamics, and information-theoretic limits on what can be learned from noisy labels. Together, these results give a formal account of why ideal noise correction fails and offer concrete guidance for designing more reliable methods for learning with noisy labels.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了即使使用完美的oracle转移矩阵T，基于噪声过渡矩阵的噪声校正方法仍然存在性能崩溃问题，这表明LNL方法的失败并非源于T估计困难，而是源于更深层次的缺陷。作者通过统一分析将宏观收敛状态、微观优化动态和信息论极限三个层面联系起来，为设计更可靠的LNL方法提供了理论指导。
AI.motivation: 基于噪声过渡矩阵T的统计一致方法在理论上有收敛到最优纯数据分类器的保证，但实际中往往不如经验方法（如样本选择）。传统观点认为这是因为难以准确估计T，因此假设给定完美的T后，噪声校正方法将恢复其理论优势。作者希望验证这一长期假设。
AI.method: 在理想条件下进行实验，向校正方法提供完美、oracle的转移矩阵T，并进行统一分析连接三个层次：宏观收敛状态、微观优化动态、以及可从噪声标签中学习的信息论极限。
AI.result: 即使在理想条件下（使用完美oracle T），噪声校正方法在训练过程中仍然遭受性能崩溃。这有力地证明失败并非根本性的T估计问题，而是源于更深层次的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 基于T估计困难的传统解释是错误的。LNL方法的失败有更深层次的根源，需要从信息论和优化动力学的角度重新理解。作者提供了正式的理论解释，说明为什么理想的噪声校正会失败，并为设计更可靠的LNL方法提供了具体指导。

title: PISmith: Reinforcement Learning-based Red Teaming for Prompt Injection Defenses
summary: Prompt injection poses serious security risks to real-world LLM applications, particularly autonomous agents. Although many defenses have been proposed, their robustness against adaptive attacks remains insufficiently evaluated, potentially creating a false sense of security. In this work, we propose PISmith, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based red-teaming framework that systematically assesses existing prompt-injection defenses by training an attack LLM to optimize injected prompts in a practical black-box setting, where the attacker can only query the defended LLM and observe its outputs. We find that directly applying standard GRPO to attack strong defenses leads to sub-optimal performance due to extreme reward sparsity -- most generated injected prompts are blocked by the defense, causing the policy's entropy to collapse before discovering effective attack strategies, while the rare successes cannot be learned effectively. In response, we introduce adaptive entropy regularization and dynamic advantage weighting to sustain exploration and amplify learning from scarce successes. Extensive evaluation on 13 benchmarks demonstrates that state-of-the-art prompt injection defenses remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks. We also compare PISmith with 7 baselines across static, search-based, and RL-based attack categories, showing that PISmith consistently achieves the highest attack success rates. Furthermore, PISmith achieves strong performance in agentic settings on InjecAgent and AgentDojo against both open-source and closed-source LLMs (e.g., GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5-nano). Our code is available at https://github.com/albert-y1n/PISmith.

AI.tldr: PISmith 是一个基于强化学习（GRPO 变体）的提示注入红队框架：在仅有黑盒访问（只能查询被防御的 LLM 并观察输出）的条件下训练一个"攻击 LLM"以生成有效的注入提示，从而系统性检验现有提示注入防御的鲁棒性。针对标准 GRPO 在强防御下"奖励极度稀疏"导致的熵坍缩与稀有个样例学习困难问题，作者提出自适应熵正则化与动态优势加权两项机制，在 13 个基准、8 种防御上显著优于 7 个基线（静态/搜索/RL），并证明当前 SOTA 防御无法同时保持任务效用与抵抗自适应攻击。
AI.motivation: 提示注入已对真实 LLM 应用（尤其是自主智能体）构成严重安全风险。当前大量提示注入防御（filter-based 如 PromptGuard、DataSentinel、PIGuard；prevention-based 如 SecAlign/Meta-SecAlign、PromptArmor、DataFilter、Instructional、Sandwich 等）在非自适应攻击下报告了接近零的攻击成功率，容易给开发者造成"虚假安全感"；已有研究表明一旦面对针对防御定制的自适应攻击者，这些防御会被显著甚至完全攻破。现有红队工具存在不足：搜索类方法（TAP、PAIR、PIArena Strategy）需对每个测试实例独立优化、推理开销大且无可迁移的攻击策略；RL-Hammer 虽用 GRPO 并联合未防御模型缓解奖励稀疏，但训练成本翻倍且未从根源解决稀疏奖励下的 RL 难题，仍表现次优。同时缺乏覆盖多类任务、多种防御的系统性评测平台。
AI.method:
【问题形式化】将攻击策略 π_φ 视为攻击 LLM，给定目标指令 x_inst、上下文 x_ctx 与注入目标 g，生成注入提示 p 并嵌入上下文（x_ctx ⊕ p），黑盒查询带防御的目标模型 M_θ，获得二值奖励 r∈{0,1}，目标为最大化期望奖励；可直接套用标准 GRPO（组内 K=15 rollout，优势 A_i=(r_i−r̄)/(σ_r+ε)，裁剪代理损失 + KL 惩罚）。

【核心问题分析】强防御下奖励极度稀疏，标准 GRPO 出现两个叠加的失效模式：(1) 熵坍缩——策略过拟合少数成功样本，输出趋于同质化，rollout 多样性崩塌，梯度消失，探索提前终止；(2) 稀释问题——即便保持探索，少数成功样本的优势被大量失败 rollout 在梯度中稀释，无法有效学习。作者指出 GRPO 自带的 KL 项不足以防熵坍缩，因为 D_KL(π_φ‖π_ref)=−H(π_φ)+H(π_φ,π_ref)，交叉熵项把策略锚定在不知攻击策略的通用参考模型上，反而抑制红队所需的偏离。

【两项机制】
1) 自适应熵正则化：用纯熵奖励替代 KL 项，并设熵上限 H_cap=0.5，仅在 H(π_φ)<H_cap 时激活熵奖励，避免过早坍缩与过早"熵爆炸"导致的语义退化；系数 β(r̄) 随当前步平均奖励自适应：r̄<τ 时 β=β_base+(β_max−β_base)·(τ−r̄)/τ，r̄≥τ 时退化为 β_base（奖励稀疏时强探索、成功率上升后快速转向利用）。附录解释这与面向推理任务的固定熵目标方法（AEPO/EPO）以及基于难度的动态采样（DAPO）根本不同：红队任务难度由防御强度决定、无法调节，且几乎所有 rollout 组全失败时 DAPO 会丢弃几乎整个 batch。
2) 动态优势加权：仅对成功 rollout（r_i=1）的优势做放大 Ā_i=A_i·γ(r̄)，失败者保持 A_i；γ(r̄)=1+ (γ_max−1)(τ−r̄)/τ（r̄<τ），γ_max=5.0，r̄≥τ 时 γ=1 恢复标准 GRPO；使稀缺成功信号主导策略更新。

【完整目标】L = −(1/K)Σ min(ρ_i Ā_i, clip(ρ_i,1−ε_c,1+ε_c)Ā_i) + L_entropy，两机制通过 r̄ 协同。

【实验设置】攻击基座 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507；非智能体任务仅用 Dolly Closed QA 前 100 条样本训练（数据高效），评估 13 个 PIArena 基准（QA: SQuAD v2、Dolly 三类；RAG: NQ、HotpotQA、MS-MARCO；长上下文: HotpotQA-Long、Qasper、GovReport、MultiNews、Passage Retrieval、LCC）；防御覆盖 Meta-SecAlign-8B 及 7 种（4 prevention + 3 filter）；基线 7 个：静态（Direct、Combined/Enhanced）、搜索（TAP、PAIR、Strategy）、RL（Vanilla GRPO、RL-Hammer）；每实例生成 N=10 个候选，报告 ASR@10/ASR@1（GPT-4o-mini 作 LLM 裁判，附 200 例人工验证 98% 一致）与无攻击下的任务效用 Utility；智能体场景为 InjecAgent（对 Meta-SecAlign-8B、GPT-4o-mini/4.1-nano/5-nano）与 AgentDojo（workspace 训练、全集测试，对 6 种官方模板攻击），并用 AgentDyn GitHub 子集扩展训练验证可扩展性。

【训练提示】统一使用"创意红队专家 + 需伪装为参考文本中的'官方更新'段落并以 <prompt> 标签包裹"的模板，所有 RL 方法共享以保证公平。超参：H_cap=0.5、β_max=0.01、β_base=0.001、γ_max=5.0、τ=0.5、K=15、lr=1e-5、ε_c=0.2、10 epochs。
AI.result:
1) 对 Meta-SecAlign-8B：静态攻击平均 ASR@1 仅 0.04/0.07，TAP/PAIR/Strategy 为 0.11/0.16/0.21；Vanilla GRPO 0.13/0.05（熵坍缩、训练动态停滞）；RL-Hammer 0.70/0.48；PISmith 平均 ASR@10=1.00、ASR@1=0.87，在 HotpotQA-Long 上 0.99/0.61（RL-Hammer 仅 0.04/0.01）。仅用 100 条 Dolly 样本训练即跨 12 个未见基准强泛化。

2) 消融（Meta-SecAlign-8B，13 基准平均 ASR@1）：Vanilla GRPO 0.05、w/o Entropy 0.09、w/o Boost 0.57、完整 PISmith 0.87，说明两机制分别负责"产生成功"与"从成功中学习"，正交且必需。

3) 效用—鲁棒性权衡（Qwen3-4B 后端，8 种防御）：无一防御同时处于"高效用+低 ASR"的理想右下区域；防御要么聚集在右上（高效用但易被攻破，如 PromptArmor ASR@1 0.92/效用 0.74、PIGuard 0.82、PromptGuard 0.89），要么聚集在左下（效用大幅损失但相对更鲁棒，如 DataSentinel 效用 0.55、ASR 0.52；DataFilter 效用 0.63、ASR 0.49）——鲁棒性靠"过度防御"以效用为代价换取。

4) 智能体场景：InjecAgent 上 PISmith 对所有目标 ASR≥0.95（GPT-4o-mini 1.0/0.99、GPT-4.1-nano 1.0/1.0、GPT-5-nano 1.0/0.95，静态攻击在 GPT-5-nano 上完全失败）；AgentDojo 上 PISmith 0.78/0.62（GPT-4o-mini）、0.81/0.64（GPT-4.1-nano）、0.38/0.24（GPT-5-nano），远超全部 6 种官方模板攻击（≤0.20）。

5) 效率：PISmith 总查询 32,000（训练 15k+推理 17k）低于 TAP 82,110、PAIR 74,460、Strategy 194,140、RL-Hammer 47,000。

6) 扩展性：训练数据多样化（加 HotpotQA-RAG/Long）使平均 ASR@1 从 0.87 升至 0.99；智能体侧加入 AgentDyn GitHub 子集使 GPT-5-nano 上 AgentDojo ASR@10/1 从 0.38/0.24 升至 0.75/0.52，AgentDyn 上达 0.88/0.60。

7) 超参敏感性：默认 (γ_max=5, H_cap=0.5, τ=0.5) 为局部最优（γ_max=1→0.57、10→0.20；H_cap=0.2→0.75、1.0→0.78；τ=0.2→0.78、0.8→0.81），且未在各基准间重调。与通用熵感知 GRPO 变体的正面对比：Vanilla GRPO 0.05/0.13、EPO 0.64/0.50、DAPO 0.28/0.14、PISmith 1.00/0.87，说明增益来自专门适配稀疏奖励的机制而非直接移植推理 RL 熵管理技术。裁判可靠性：两名标注者 100% 一致，与 GPT-4o-mini 裁判 98% 一致（4 例分歧均为保守处理的假阳性）。
AI.conclusion: 结论：当前 SOTA 提示注入防御在 RL 驱动的自适应攻击者面前依然脆弱，且无法同时兼顾任务效用与鲁棒性——不存在处于"高效用、低 ASR"理想区域的防御，现有的相对鲁棒性往往以显著效用损失为代价。因此当前 LLM 与其提示注入防御尚不足以支撑安全的真实部署，亟需开发既鲁棒又保持效用的新型防御。作者认为 PISmith 的价值不仅在于事后评测，还可反向用于防御：例如参考 OpenAI 的 GPT-Red 自博弈红队思路，将攻击者与目标模型在防御的后训练阶段闭环协同训练，让防御持续面对"当前最强攻击者"而非静态攻击模板集合；同时该方法对更强基座（如 DeepSeek V4 Pro、GLM-5.2 等）具有可扩展潜力，因为其奖励条件化机制不依赖特定架构。局限与后续方向包括：默认攻击模型仅为 4B 规模、更强攻击基座的系统评测留待未来；伦理方面承认红队工具的双用风险，遵循负责任披露原则，仅在公开基准与受控研究环境中实验，代码将以清晰的用途说明发布。

title: OpenACMv2: An Accuracy-Constrained Co-Optimization Framework for Approximate DCiM
summary: Digital Compute-in-Memory (DCiM) accelerates neural networks by reducing data movement. Approximate DCiM can further improve power-performance-area (PPA), but demands accuracy-constrained co-optimization across coupled architecture and transistor-level choices. Building on OpenYield, we introduce Accuracy-Constrained Co-Optimization (ACCO) and present OpenACMv2, an open framework that operationalizes ACCO via two-level optimization: (1) accuracy-constrained architecture search of compressor combinations and SRAM macro parameters, driven by a fast GNN-based surrogate for PPA and error; and (2) variation- and PVT-aware transistor sizing for standard cells and SRAM bitcells using Monte Carlo. By decoupling ACCO into architecture-level exploration and circuit-level sizing, OpenACMv2 integrates classic single- and multi-objective optimizers to deliver strong PPA-accuracy tradeoffs and robust convergence. The workflow is compatible with FreePDK45 and OpenROAD, supporting reproducible evaluation and easy adoption. Experiments demonstrate significant PPA improvements under controlled accuracy budgets, enabling rapid "what-if" exploration for approximate DCiM. The framework is available on https://github.com/ShenShan123/OpenACM.

AI.tldr: OpenACMv2 是 OpenACM（首个开源 SRAM 近似 CiM 编译器）的升级版，基于 OpenYield 提出"精度约束协同优化"（ACCO）：用自顶向下两级优化——Level-1 架构搜索（压缩器组合/部分积列近似 + SRAM 宏参数，由自研 GNN 代理模型 PEA-GNN 快速评估 PPA 与误差）+ Level-2 晶体管级尺寸调整（标准单元与 6T 位线单元，PVT/工艺变化感知 Monte Carlo），在给定 MRED/NMED 预算下把近似 DCiM 的能耗-延迟积（PDP）降低约 50% 以上，Level-2 再贡献个位数百分比的 PDP 改善，且不损害任务精度。
AI.motivation: 数字计算存内（DCiM）通过在 SRAM 附近/内部执行低精度运算消除数据搬运，显著改善 PPA；近似计算（近似乘法器、压缩器）可进一步放大该收益，但带来一个困难的硬协同设计问题：在架构级选择（压缩器拓扑与分配、部分积列截断/门控、SRAM bank 组织）与晶体管级选择（器件尺寸、门分解、LVT/HVT 分配）之间权衡精度（MRED/NMED）与 PPA。这些折中是非凸的、对 PVT 与工艺变化敏感且强烈依赖 SRAM 配置，手工调参不可行。已有的 DCiM 优化器（AutoDCIM、SynDCIM、ARCTIC、OpenC2）面向精确算术且与应用无关，缺乏精度感知建模；而 ACCO 式循环需要数百万次"what-if"查询，单次 16-bit 查询用传统综合/仿真需数十秒，无法支撑内环搜索。此外，现有工作大多只做晶体管级尺寸或架构级优化之一，尚无统一开源框架能在精度约束下联合推理精度、拓扑与尺寸。
AI.method:
框架以 OpenACM 的端到端 DCiM 流程（图1：PE = 乘法器 + SRAM 宏）与 OpenYield 的变化感知分析为基础，实现 ACCO 的两级解耦优化。
Level-1（架构级）：(a) 近似乘法器——N 位乘法器的 2N 个部分积列中仅低显著列 J_L 可近似，高位列保持精确；低列提供 t=9 个可配置压缩器槽位，压缩器库含 K=8 种类型，编码向量 a∈{0..K-1}^t，搜索空间 K^t=8^9；定义 ED、MRED（在 R_exact>0 的子集上避免除零）、NMED（以 R_max 归一化）与 D/P/A/PDP，并以 (MRED, PDP) 为目标、NMED≤ε 为硬约束的多目标问题（式3）。(b) 构建 PEA-GNN 代理模型：将压缩器分配编码为与压缩层级对齐的阶段化图 G=(V,E)，节点为组合逻辑（HA/FA/精确与近似 4-2 压缩器），边为互连；节点特征由真值表 H^(y)、输入位概率 {p_j}（均匀时 0.5）导出的输入组合权重 ω 与输入概率向量 p_in 与误差向量 e^(y) 逐元素相乘融合 h_v=p_in⊙e^(y)；各阶段子图内用 GraphSAGE 消息传递（AGG 如 mean），T 阶段后拼接关键节点集 V_approx∪V_last 得全局表示 g，共享 MLP 回归头输出 (MRED̂, NMED̂, D̂, Â, P̂) 并用 Softplus 保证非负。(c) 优化器集成：MOEA/D（加权 Tchebycheff 标量化）、NSGA-II（非支配排序+拥挤距离）、SMAC（随机森林代理采集函数）、MOBO（期望超体积改进），配合 PEA-GNN 快速生成精度-PDP Pareto 前沿。(d) SRAM 宏级：枚举 (行数 r, 列数 c, mux 比 μ, 阵列数 n_a) 满足容量约束 r×c×n_a=Capacity（实验为 4KB×8=32,768 bit），候选按 2 的幂网格 r∈{2..512}、c∈{2..256}，用 SPICE 评估读写延迟/功耗并定义 FOM=-log10(P_max·√A_bank·D_max)；单目标优化器 CBO（GP 采集函数×可行性先验）、PSO（惯性+个体/全局最优吸引）、SA（高斯邻域提议与温度退火）最大化 FOM。
Level-2（电路级）：(a) 标准单元定制——对 8 类压缩器的 CMOS 门级实现（INV、NAND/NOR、XOR/XNOR、AOI/OAI、AND/OR、BUF 等），固定沟道长度、以晶体管宽度为变量，按对称性分组 w=(w_1..w_q)∈R_+^q 并加上下界；用 SPICE 仿真输出电压，按技术阈值 (V_OL^max, V_OH^min) 分类，约束 c(V_out(w;b_i)) 必须等于目标真值表（即逻辑功能正确性硬约束），目标为 min(PDP(w), A(w))，可选以各 PVT 角的最坏值聚合（如 D^max=max_c D(w;c)）。(b) SRAM 位线单元——沿用 OpenYield 的 6T 位线单元流程，跨 PVT 角的 Monte Carlo，最坏情况聚合 hold/read/write SNM、读写延迟与动态功耗，遵循 OpenYield 的单/多目标与求解器设置。
平台与实验：Intel Xeon Gold 6330 + A100，PyTorch/PyG + Adam；基于 Nangate45 开源单元库自动生成数据集，5ns 时钟、10fF 输出负载，用 OpenROAD + OpenSTA + VCS 做 EDA 基准；全流程兼容 FreePDK45 与 OpenROAD，代码开源。
AI.result:
(1) PEA-GNN 精度与速度：8-bit 下 MRED/NMED 误差 2.17%/1.84%，Delay/Area/Power 误差 ≤0.30%，各输出 R²>0.94（MRED 0.998、NMED 0.996）；16-bit 下 MRED/NMED 误差 4.73%/2.30%，PPA 偏差 ≤0.25%，R²>0.95。推理时间 0.26s vs 37s（142×）、0.25s vs 116s（464×）。
(2) 架构级：MOEA/D 收敛最稳定，故选 Case1–Case5 五个 MRED 预算点。8-bit 图像融合任务中 MRED 从 5.88e-2 收紧到 4.25e-3，PSNR 由 47.03 提升到 58.57，PDP 由 193fJ 降至 240fJ（Base/Yang1 为 484fJ、PSNR 69.81）——ACCO 通过预算避免"过度精确"造成能量浪费；Level-2 调尺寸在不改变 PSNR 的前提下进一步降 PDP（如 Case5：240→229fJ，PSNR 58.57→64.31）。16-bit CIFAR-10 推理在跨约一个数量级的 MRED 预算下 Top-1/Top-5 变化 <1%，多个 Pareto 点在精度与 Base 相当的同时显著降低 PDP（3874→1216/1219/1222/1254/1337fJ），Level-2 一致再降 PDP。
(3) 晶体管级：Sabetz 压缩器上 MOEA/D 得到最优 Pareto 收敛与最佳 PDP-面积权衡；对全部 8 种压缩器用 MOEA/D 优化后，Pareto 前沿均位于标准尺寸基线（菱形标记）左侧，表明尺寸优化带来一致改进，且 MRED 保持不变（满足 ACCO 不破坏精度预算）。
(4) SRAM：架构级扫描显示小阵列（行/列少）能耗低但延迟由外围电路主导（数据复用、预译码）而更长；增行数减少阵列数则延迟降低但位线负载增大、动态功耗上升；功耗-延迟 Pareto 前沿呈凹形，最优设计聚集在"肘部"（外围开销与位线开关平衡）。Level-2 位线尺寸带来的延迟/动态功耗收益有限（非理想外围电路压缩了安全尺寸窗口，激进探索在 SPICE 中失败），说明 SRAM 的 PPA 主要由架构级决定。
(5) 总体：两级 ACCO 大部分效率收益来自 Level-1（PDP 约 50%+ 降低），Level-2 提供额外个位数 PDP 改善并保持精度不变。
AI.conclusion: OpenACMv2 通过 ACCO 把应用级精度预算提升为前端设计循环中的一等约束，并以"自顶向下分而治之"的两级流程（PEA-GNN 引导的架构探索 → 变化/PVT 感知的电路级尺寸）联合优化近似 DCiM 的架构与晶体管级选择，在固定精度预算下把精度-PDP Pareto 前沿整体左移，在多种压缩器族与位宽下实现更优的 PPA-精度折中，并支持快速"what-if"探索与可复现评估。局限包括：代理模型在 PVT 角上的保真度与覆盖度仍有限；目标范围偏窄（仅 PDP 与精度，未纳入吞吐、漏电、IR drop、布线拥塞）；后端签核集成不完整（布局布线、寄生提取、串扰）；SRAM 宏与位线/外围电路的协同优化深度不足。

title: 3DTCR: A Physics-Based Generative Framework for Vortex-Following 3D Reconstruction to Improve Tropical Cyclone Intensity Forecasting
summary: Tropical cyclone (TC) intensity forecasting remains challenging as current numerical and AI-based weather models fail to satisfactorily represent extreme TC structure and intensity. Although intensity time-series forecasting has achieved significant advances, it outputs intensity sequences rather than the three-dimensional inner-core fine-scale structure and physical mechanisms governing TC evolution. High-resolution numerical simulations can capture these features but remain computationally expensive and inefficient for large-scale operational applications. Here we present 3DTCR, a physics-based generative framework combining physical constraints with generative AI efficiency for 3D TC structure reconstruction. Trained on a six-year, 3-km-resolution moving-domain WRF dataset, 3DTCR enables region-adaptive vortex-following reconstruction using conditional Flow Matching(CFM), optimized via latent domain adaptation and two-stage transfer learning. The framework mitigates limitations imposed by low-resolution targets and over-smoothed forecasts, improving the representation of TC inner-core structure and intensity while maintaining track stability. Results demonstrate that 3DTCR outperforms the ECMWF high-resolution forecasting system (ECMWF-HRES) in TC intensity prediction at nearly all lead times up to 5 days and reduces the RMSE of maximum WS10M by 36.5\% relative to its FuXi inputs. These findings highlight 3DTCR as a physics-based generative framework that efficiently resolves fine-scale structures at lower computational cost, which may offer a promising avenue for improving TC intensity forecasting.

AI.tldr: 3DTCR是一个基于物理约束的生成式AI框架,用于热带气旋三维结构重建。该模型结合条件流匹配(CFM)、潜在域自适应和两阶段迁移学习技术,在3公里分辨率WRF数据上训练,在5天预报时效内强度预测性能优于ECMWF-HRES,最大10米风速均方根误差降低36.5%。
AI.motivation: Current numerical and AI-based weather models fail to satisfactorily represent extreme tropical cyclone (TC) structure and intensity. Existing intensity time-series forecasting only outputs intensity sequences rather than the three-dimensional inner-core fine-scale structure and physical mechanisms governing TC evolution. High-resolution numerical simulations can capture these features but remain computationally expensive for large-scale operational applications.
AI.method: 3DTCR, a physics-based generative framework combining physical constraints with generative AI efficiency for 3D TC structure reconstruction. It uses conditional Flow Matching (CFM), optimized via latent domain adaptation and two-stage transfer learning. Trained on a six-year, 3-km-resolution moving-domain WRF dataset.
AI.result: 3DTCR outperforms the ECMWF high-resolution forecasting system (ECMWF-HRES) in TC intensity prediction at nearly all lead times up to 5 days and reduces the RMSE of maximum WS10M by 36.5% relative to its FuXi inputs. It improves representation of TC inner-core structure and intensity while maintaining track stability.
AI.conclusion: 3DTCR as a physics-based generative framework efficiently resolves fine-scale structures at lower computational cost, offering a promising avenue for improving TC intensity forecasting.

title: Causal Cellular Context Transfer Learning (C3TL): An Efficient Architecture for Prediction of Unseen Perturbation Effects
comment: 12 Pages, 3 figures, Keywords: perturbation prediction, context transfer, lightweight, machine learning
summary: Predicting the effects of chemical and genetic perturbations on quantitative cell states is a central challenge in computational biology, molecular medicine and drug discovery. Recent work has leveraged large-scale single-cell data and massive foundation models to address this task. However, such computational resources and extensive datasets are not always accessible in academic or clinical settings, hence limiting utility. Here we propose a lightweight framework for perturbation effect prediction that exploits the structured nature of biological interventions and specific inductive biases/invariances. Our approach leverages available information concerning perturbation effects to allow generalization to novel contexts and requires only widely-available bulk molecular data. Extensive testing, comparing predictions of context-specific perturbation effects against real, large-scale interventional experiments, demonstrates accurate prediction in new contexts. The proposed approach is competitive with SOTA foundation models but requires simpler data, much smaller model sizes and less time. Focusing on robust bulk signals and efficient architectures, we show that accurate prediction of perturbation effects is possible without proprietary hardware or very large models, hence opening up ways to leverage causal learning approaches in biomedicine generally.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级框架，利用生物干预的结构化特性和特定归纳偏置/不变性，仅使用广泛可用的批量分子数据即可准确预测遗传和化学扰动在新的细胞上下文中的效应，无需大规模单细胞数据或大型基础模型。
AI.motivation: 当前大规模单细胞数据和基础模型虽能预测扰动效应，但在学术或临床环境中难以获取且资源消耗大，限制了实际应用。需要一种轻量级、低资源需求的扰动效应预测方法。
AI.method: 利用生物干预的结构化特性（structured nature）和特定归纳偏置/ invariance，采用高效架构，仅依赖广泛可用的批量分子数据（bulk molecular data），无需大规模单细胞数据集。
AI.result: 在多个测试中，将context-specific扰动效应预测与真实大规模干预实验进行比较，证明了在新上下文中的准确预测。该方法与SOTA基础模型性能相当，但使用更简单的数据、更小的模型和更少的时间。
AI.conclusion: 准确预测扰动效应无需专有硬件或超大规模模型，通过利用鲁棒的批量信号和高效架构即可实现，为在生物医学领域更广泛地应用因果学习方法开辟了道路。

title: Fractals made Practical: Denoising Diffusion as Partitioned Iterated Function Systems
summary:
What is a diffusion model actually doing when it turns noise into a photograph?
  We show that the deterministic DDIM reverse chain operates as a Partitioned Iterated Function System (PIFS) and that this framework serves as a unified design language for denoising diffusion model schedules, architectures, and training objectives. From the PIFS structure we derive three computable geometric quantities: a per-step contraction threshold $L^*_t$, a diagonal expansion function $f_t(λ)$ and a global expansion threshold $λ^{**}$. These quantities require no model evaluation and fully characterize the denoising dynamics. They structurally explain the two-regime behavior of diffusion models: global context assembly at high noise via diffuse cross-patch attention and fine-detail synthesis at low noise via patch-by-patch suppression release in strict variance order. Self-attention emerges as the natural primitive for PIFS contraction. The Kaplan-Yorke dimension of the PIFS attractor is determined analytically through a discrete Moran equation on the Lyapunov spectrum.
  Through the study of the fractal geometry of the PIFS, we derive three optimal design criteria and show that four prominent empirical design choices (the cosine schedule offset, resolution-dependent logSNR shift, Min-SNR loss weighting, and Align Your Steps sampling) each arise as approximate solutions to our explicit geometric optimization problems tuning theory into practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文将扩散模型的确定性DDIM逆过程建模为分区迭代函数系统(PIFS)，提出了一套统一的设计语言来解释去噪扩散模型的调度策略、架构和训练目标。通过PIFS结构推导出了三个可计算的几何量：每步收缩阈值L*_t、对角扩展函数f_t(λ)和全局扩展阈值λ**。这些量无需模型评估即可完全刻画去噪动力学，并从结构上解释扩散模型的两阶段行为：高噪声时的全局上下文组装和低噪声时的精细细节合成。
AI.motivation: 理解扩散模型从噪声生成图像的实际工作机制，特别是从理论几何角度解释其去噪动态过程。
AI.method:
1.将DDIM逆过程建模为分区迭代函数系统(PIFS)
2.推导三个几何量：L*_t、f_t(λ)、λ**
3.利用Lyapunov谱和离散Moran方程计算PIFS吸引子的Kaplan-Yorke维度
4.从PIFS分形几何推导最优设计标准
AI.result:
1.自我注意力自然涌现为PIFS收缩的原语
2.揭示扩散模型的两阶段行为机制
3.四个经验设计选择（余弦调度偏移、分辨率相关logSNR移位、Min-SNR损失加权、Align Your Steps采样）均可近似为几何优化问题的解
AI.conclusion: 通过PIFS框架，从分形几何角度为扩散模型提供了统一的理论解释，连接了理论优化问题与实际经验设计。

title: Influence Malleability in Linearized Attention: Dual Implications of Non-Convergent NTK Dynamics
summary: Understanding the theoretical foundations of attention mechanisms remains challenging due to their complex, non-linear dynamics. This work reveals a fundamental trade-off in the learning dynamics of linearized attention. Using a linearized attention mechanism with exact correspondence to a data-dependent Gram-induced kernel, both empirical and theoretical analysis through the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) framework shows that linearized attention does not converge to its infinite-width NTK limit, even at large widths. A spectral amplification result establishes this formally: the attention transformation cubes the Gram matrix's condition number, requiring width $m = Ω(κ^6)$ for convergence, a threshold that exceeds any practical width for natural image datasets. This non-convergence is characterized through influence malleability, the capacity to dynamically alter reliance on training examples. Attention exhibits 6--9$\times$ higher malleability than ReLU networks, with dual implications: its data-dependent kernel can reduce approximation error by aligning with task structure, but this same sensitivity increases susceptibility to adversarial manipulation of training data. These findings suggest that attention's power and vulnerability share a common origin in its departure from the kernel regime.

AI.tldr: 线性化注意力（f_att(X)=XX^T X）的核恒等式为 K=G^3（Gram 矩阵的矩阵立方），注意力把有效条件数放大三次，故 NTK 收敛所需宽度为 m=Ω(κ_d(G)^6·n·log n)（MNIST >10^24、CIFAR-10 >10^29），任何实用宽度都无法进入核机制。论文据此提出"影响可塑性"（influence malleability）指标：注意力网络的影响翻转率为 ReLU 的 2–9 倍（多分类 6–9 倍），并指出注意力的能力与脆弱性同源于其偏离核机制。
AI.motivation: 现代影响函数方法（TRAK、DataInf、EK-FAC）都建立在"模型处于核机制（kernel regime）附近、一阶 NTK 近似全程成立"这一前提上；当这些方法被直接用于 Transformer 做数据审计、投毒检测、代表样本选择时，该前提被默认成立而缺乏验证。由于 softmax 注意力含指数非线性，精确 NTK 刻画被排除，线性化注意力遂成为唯一可解析的规范代理。作者提出的核心问题即：线性化注意力何时（若能）进入核机制？若能，影响方法继承其理论保证；若在任何实用宽度下结构性不可能，则这些影响分数在部署的 Transformer 上缺乏根据且可被利用。此前 Tensor Programs (Yang, 2020) Remark 7.4 明确将非 BP 类架构的 NTK 收敛性搁置，本工作解析了这一遗留问题。
AI.method: 1) 构造参数无关的线性化注意力 f_att(X)=XX^TX（等价于恒等投影 + softmax 一阶泰勒展开），与两层 ReLU MLP 组成顺序架构 MLP-Attn（转导式，X 为全体训练集），并作行 ℓ2 归一化。2) 定理 4.2 给出精确核表征：K_LinAttn(x_i,x_j)=Σ_{k,ℓ}(x_i^T x_k)(x_k^T x_ℓ)(x_ℓ^T x_j)=[G^3]_{ij}，即数据依赖的四阶、参数无关、传递性（x_i→x_k→x_ℓ→x_j）核；定理 4.3 给出顺序架构的无限宽 NTK（ReLU NTK 作用于变换后特征）。3) 定理 4.8：用 SVD（Lemma B.11 谱传递）与矩阵 Bernstein 不等式证明 G̃=G^3、κ_d(G̃)=κ_d(G)^3，并推出 NTK 收敛需 m=Ω(κ_d(G)^6 n log n/ε²)，对比 2L-ReLU 的 m=Ω(n log n/ε²)；命题 4.11 给出未归一化 softmax 的指数型放大 κ·exp(2(λ1−λn)/√d)；命题 4.13 推广到可训练 QKV（投影 Gram 矩阵 G_W）。4) 定理 4.4/命题 4.6/附录 C：影响稳定性上界 ε/[λ(λ−ε)]、数据依赖核敏感度 ≤6λ1(G)^2 ε、内在影响敏感度 S=L_K‖y‖/λ²、偏差–方差–可塑性分解、命题 C.9 的偏差降低。5) 定义影响可塑性：基于经验有限宽 NTK 的留一影响（Sherman–Morrison，无需重训）与符号翻转率 FlipRate（top-10% 高影响样本，PGD ε=0.03），辅以 Spearman ρ 与 Top-K 稳定性；干预策略为 Curated/Transformed/Adversarial。6) 实验：MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10（含二分类子集），宽度 4→4096 精确计算 NTK 距离 ‖f_m−f_NTK‖，FGSM/PGD/MIM 攻击，对照 2L-ReLU 与 MLP-Attn，并做 PGD 对抗训练对照、损失景观与特征图崩塌诊断。
AI.result: 理论：注意力把 Gram 矩阵条件数立方化（κ_d(G̃)=κ_d(G)^3），NTK 收敛宽度门槛 m=Ω(κ_d(G)^6 n log n)；实测 κ_d(G)≈1.2×10^3 (MNIST)、8.7×10^3 (CIFAR-10)，对应门槛 m≫10^24 与 m≫10^29，比已知最大模型高 12–17 个数量级（实用宽度上限约 10^5，GPT-3 为 12,288）。经验：2L-ReLU 的 NTK 距离随宽度单调下降（如 CIFAR-10 246.2→101.7→56.9），MLP-Attn 则不降反升/非单调（MNIST 10.3→33.3→43.4；CIFAR-10 3.7→10.4→12.6），与定理 4.8 一致，属特征学习而非惰性训练。可塑性：多分类设置下注意力影响翻转率为 ReLU 的 6–9 倍（MNIST PGD 28.9% vs 3.3%），二分类 MNIST 仍 3–4.9 倍，CIFAR-10 二分类因 κ_d 降低而约为 1 倍，与谱论证一致；对抗训练把 ReLU 的可塑性从 3.3% 提升到 43.4%，达到注意力的结构性水平，说明注意力天然带有这种敏感性。Softmax/指数注意力虽显示近零 NTK 距离，但特征图余弦相似度为 1.000、核退化为秩-1，属测量伪影而非真正收敛。双向性：数据依赖核在目标与数据几何对齐时降低偏差（命题 C.9），同时产生 O(√n λ1(G)) 的可塑性缺口（命题 C.13），并在 Curated/Transformed 干预下比 ReLU 提升精度 2.3–2.6%。
AI.conclusion: 线性化注意力被证明在任何实用宽度下都无法进入核机制，根源是立方条件数结构；该结构同时解释了注意力影响分数的极端不稳定（2–9 倍可塑性缺口）与"偏差降低—对抗脆弱"的双向权衡，即注意力的能力与脆弱性同源于偏离核机制。由于 κ_d(G) 可用随机化 SVD 在 O(nd log n) 时间内、无需梯度估计，该诊断可推广到任意规模；实践建议为：κ_d(G)>10^2 即判定处于非收敛区，对影响方法降低置信阈值、跨 checkpoint 集成、定期重排序，并在主动学习流程中分阶段重排。局限：结论基于线性化（softmax 一阶）代理与转导设定，实测宽度上限 4096，κ^6 宽度界为充分条件而非紧的匹配下界，训练后（而非初始化时）的核演化尚无理论刻画；向完整 Transformer、多头注意力、层归一化、选择性 SSM 的推广被列为开放问题。

title: Breaking the Tuning Barrier: Zero-Hyperparameters Yield Multi-Corner Analysis Via Learned Priors
summary: Yield Multi-Corner Analysis validates circuits across 25+ Process-Voltage-Temperature corners, resulting in a combinatorial simulation cost of $O(K \times N)$ where $K$ denotes corners and $N$ exceeds $10^4$ samples per corner. Existing methods face a fundamental trade-off: simple models achieve automation but fail on nonlinear circuits, while advanced AI models capture complex behaviors but require hours of hyperparameter tuning per design iteration, forming the Tuning Barrier. We break this barrier by replacing engineered priors (i.e., model specifications) with learned priors from a foundation model pre-trained on millions of regression tasks. This model performs in-context learning, instantly adapting to each circuit without tuning or retraining. Its attention mechanism automatically transfers knowledge across corners by identifying shared circuit physics between operating conditions. Combined with an automated feature selector (1152D to 48D), our method matches state-of-the-art accuracy (mean MREs as low as 0.11\%) with zero tuning, reducing total validation cost by over $10\times$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于基础模型的电路良率多角落分析方法，通过上下文学习和自动特征选择，在无需调参的情况下实现与最先进精度相当的预测精度，并将验证成本降低10倍以上。
AI.motivation: yield多角落验证需要在25+个PVT角落进行O(K×N)规模的组合模拟，其中N>10^4样本/角落。现有方法面临根本性权衡：简单模型可自动化但无法处理非线性电路，先进AI模型能捕获复杂行为但每次设计迭代需要数小时的超参数调优，形成"调优壁垒"。
AI.method: 用从数百万回归任务预训练的基础模型取代人工设计的先验知识（模型规范）。该模型通过上下文学习即时适应每个电路，无需调优或重训练。其注意力机制自动识别不同角落间共享的电路物理特性，实现跨角落知识迁移。结合自动化特征选择器（1152维降至48维）。
AI.result: 实现最先进精度（平均MRE低至0.11%），零调优，总验证成本降低超过10倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法突破了AI模型在电路设计中的调优壁垒，证明预训练基础模型的上下文学习能力可有效应用于复杂电路建模，为大规模电路良率验证提供了一种高效且准确的解决方案。

title: ZO-SAM: Zero-Order Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Efficient Sparse Training
summary: Deep learning models, despite their impressive achievements, suffer from high computational costs and memory requirements, limiting their usability in resource-constrained environments. Sparse neural networks significantly alleviate these constraints by dramatically reducing parameter count and computational overhead. However, existing sparse training methods often experience chaotic and noisy gradient signals, severely hindering convergence and generalization performance, particularly at high sparsity levels. To tackle this critical challenge, we propose Zero-Order Sharpness-Aware Minimization (ZO-SAM), a novel optimization framework that strategically integrates zero-order optimization within the SAM approach. Unlike traditional SAM, ZO-SAM requires only a single backpropagation step during perturbation, selectively utilizing zero-order gradient estimations. This innovative approach reduces the backpropagation computational cost by half compared to conventional SAM, significantly lowering gradient variance and effectively eliminating associated computational overhead. By harnessing SAM's capacity for identifying flat minima, ZO-SAM stabilizes the training process and accelerates convergence. These efficiency gains are particularly important in sparse training scenarios, where computational cost is the primary bottleneck that limits the practicality of SAM. Moreover, models trained with ZO-SAM exhibit improved robustness under distribution shift, further broadening its practicality in real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: ZO-SAM 将零阶（ZO）优化注入 SAM 框架：仅在"扰动步"用随机梯度估计（RGE，仅需函数值求值、无需反向传播）近似扰动方向，而在"梯度更新步"保留精确的一阶反传梯度，从而把 SAM 每步两次前反向的开销压缩为一次反传。该方法专为稀疏训练设计，能显著降低高稀疏率下的梯度方差、获得更平坦的损失曲面并加快收敛，同时在精度、吞吐与分布偏移鲁棒性上取得比 SAM 家族更优的综合权衡。
AI.motivation: 深度模型计算与内存开销大，稀疏网络（只保留少量激活权重）是资源受限部署（边缘设备、移动端、大规模预训练）的有效路径。但现有稀疏训练方法（静态如 LTH/SNIP/GraSP，动态如 SET/DSR/RigL/MEST）在高稀疏率下普遍出现"混乱且噪声化的梯度信号"，收敛慢、泛化差；作者进一步实验表明稀疏化会把损失曲面从平滑宽阔盆地变为陡峭狭窄地形。SAM 已被证明可引导优化走向平坦极小、降低梯度方差并提升泛化，但其每步需要两次完整反向传播，计算开销翻倍，在以"省算力"为初衷的稀疏训练场景中代价不可接受。作者因此提出核心问题：能否重构 SAM 的结构以消除每步的双重反向传播，同时保留其平坦极小优势？零阶优化（ZO）仅用函数值评估估计梯度、天然零额外反传，但完全用 ZO 替换一阶梯度会引入额外近似噪声、损害更新精度与稳定性。
AI.method: 问题形式化：以二值掩码 M∈{0,1}^d 约束 ||M||_0≤k（等价于目标稀疏率 α），优化 min_{θ,M} L_S(f(x; θ⊙M), y)。核心设计是把 ZO 估计仅放在 SAM 的第一步（扰动步）。(1) 扰动步：用随机梯度估计 RGE 替代反传梯度，ĝ = (1/m)Σ_{i=1}^m [L((θ+δu_i)⊙M) − L((θ−δu_i)⊙M)]/(2δ)·u_i，u_i~N(0,I)，然后 ε = ρ·ĝ/||ĝ||，θ̃=(θ+ε)⊙M；该步只需前向函数评估，无反向传播。(2) 更新步：仍在扰动点 θ̃ 处做一次精确一阶反传 g_t=∇L_S(θ̃)，并按 θ_{t+1}=(θ_t − η_t(g_t+λθ_t))⊙M 更新（含权重衰减并再施加掩码）。选择 RGE 而非坐标式估计 CGE，因 CGE 需 d 次评估（深网不可行），而 RGE 只需 m≪d 次评估，且随机方向聚合可整体探索损失曲面、避免过度强调个别稀疏参数、减少尖锐极小；选择放在扰动步而非更新步，因扰动步只需方向、不需要高精度，而更新步需精确梯度以保证稳定性。稀疏方法可自由调节 m 以适配算力预算。整体为"ZO 探索 + 一阶利用"的混合框架。
AI.result: 精度：作为即插即用优化器叠加在 7 种稀疏基线（LT、SNIP、GraSP、SET、DSR、RigL、MEST）之上，在 CIFAR-10/100、ResNet-32/50、90%/95%/98% 稀疏率下全面提升（ResNet-32：CIFAR-10 增益 0.38%–2.31%，CIFAR-100 增益 0.45%–2.54%；ResNet-50 最高 +1.04%/+1.56%）。Transformer 上 ImageNet-1K：DeiT-Small@70% 稀疏 +1.17%，DeiT-Tiny@50% 稀疏 +1.14%（如 SNIP+ZO-SAM 达 79.31%/71.32%）。效率（ResNet-32，90% 稀疏）：ZO-SAM 4349.53 img/s（为 SGD 的 76.67%），而 SAM 仅 2704.84（47.67%）、ESAM 2297（40.48%）、GSAM 2701（47.60%），LookSAM(k=10) 4272（75.29%）但精度低；WRN-28-10 上 576.01 img/s vs SAM 354.94。收敛速度：达到 90% 精度的 epoch 数 70（sp=0.9）/88（sp=0.95），快于 SGD 的 104/131、ESAM 75/92、LookSAM(k=5) 79/94、GSAM 84/113。损失曲面：各稀疏率下盆地明显更宽更平滑；梯度方差在高稀疏下显著降低。特征图：早层边缘更连贯、中层纹理噪声更少、深层语义区域聚集更紧。鲁棒性（CIFAR-10-C，SNIP@90%）：腐蚀集精度 62.70%，比 SNIP 提升 3.10%，Δ=30.68 为所有对比方法中最小（ESAM 32.21、GSAM 32.10、SNIP 32.99）。
AI.conclusion: ZO-SAM 通过"扰动步零阶、更新步一阶"的选择性集成，把 SAM 从双反传改造为单反传的高效框架，缓解了稀疏训练中计算效率与优化稳定性之间的权衡。它在不牺牲平坦极小性质的前提下显著降低了计算开销并提升了训练稳定性、泛化性能与分布偏移鲁棒性，使 SAM 类锐度感知优化在资源受限的稀疏训练与边缘部署场景中变得可行，是精度—效率权衡较优的实用方案。局限方面：精度略低于 SAM/GSAM（ResNet-32 上 93.50% vs 93.77%/93.72%），且零阶估计引入的近似噪声在超高稀疏或特殊任务上可能带来额外敏感性。

title: Representation Learning for Spatiotemporal Physical Systems
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI & PDE
summary: Machine learning approaches to spatiotemporal physical systems have primarily focused on next-frame prediction, with the goal of learning an accurate emulator for the system's evolution in time. However, these emulators are computationally expensive to train and are subject to performance pitfalls, such as compounding errors during autoregressive rollout. In this work, we take a different perspective and look at scientific tasks further downstream of predicting the next frame, such as estimation of a system's governing physical parameters. Accuracy on these tasks offers a uniquely quantifiable glimpse into the physical relevance of the representations of these models. We evaluate the effectiveness of general-purpose self-supervised methods in learning physics-grounded representations that are useful for downstream scientific tasks. Surprisingly, we find that not all methods designed for physical modeling outperform generic self-supervised learning methods on these tasks, and methods that learn in the latent space (e.g., joint embedding predictive architectures, or JEPAs) outperform those optimizing pixel-level prediction objectives. Code is available at https://github.com/helenqu/physical-representation-learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在自监督学习框架下学习物理嵌入式表示的方法，并评估这些表示对下游科学任务（如估计系统物理参数）的有效性。研究发现，针对物理建模设计的方法并不总是优于通用自监督方法，而潜在空间学习方法（如JEPA）优于像素级预测方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的时序物理系统机器学习方法主要关注下一帧预测，但这类方法训练成本高，且在自回归展开时会出现误差累积问题。此外，下游科学任务（如估计系统物理参数）更能直接反映模型对物理相关性的理解，但尚未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 作者评估了多种通用自监督方法（包括对比学习、掩码重建、联合嵌入预测架构JEPA等）在学习物理嵌入式表示方面的效果，并测试这些表示对下游科学任务的实用性。
AI.result: 令人惊讶的是，并非所有专门为物理建模设计的方法都优于通用自监督学习方法；相反，在潜在空间中进行学习的方法（如JEPA）表现优于优化像素级预测目标的方法。
AI.conclusion: 自监督学习方法能够学习到对下游科学任务有用的物理嵌入式表示；潜在空间学习方法（而非像素级预测）是学习物理相关表示的有效途径，这为物理驱动的表示学习提供了新的研究方向。
